title: HR & Admin Assistant Manager
description:
**About Us**

Janam Corporation is a diamond manufacturing and export business. We are based at Bharat Diamond Bourse, Mumbai. We cut and polish rough diamonds. We also source finished diamonds. We sell to retailers and wholesalers in India and the US.

Our corporate office is a small, close-knit team. We work by five values. These are Ownership & Accountability, Integrity & Trust, Excellence & Consistency, Customer First and Growth Mindset.

**The Role**

The HR & Admin Assistant Manager looks after HR and administration for our corporate office. You will make sure our HR policies are followed and our employee records are complete. You will manage hiring, onboarding, travel and the day-to-day running of the office. You will also provide executive support to the Director. This role reports to the Director.

**What You Will Do**

***HR & Compliance***

•     Roll out all HR policies to the team and make sure they are followed

•     Get signed policy acknowledgements from every employee

•     Track attendance, leave, late coming and advance requests

•     Report any exceptions to the Director

•     Keep all employee records complete and up to date

•     Coordinate the yearly performance appraisal process

•     Maintain warning letters and other disciplinary records

***Recruitment & Onboarding***

•     Prepare job descriptions for open positions

•     Source candidates and do the first round of screening

•     Schedule final interviews with the Director

•     Complete onboarding for every new joiner in their first week

***Executive Support to the Director***

•     Manage the Director’s calendar and meetings

•     Prepare agendas and share meeting notes

•     Follow up on action points with the team

***Travel Management***

•     Plan domestic and international travel for the Director and the team

•     Handle visas, flights, hotels and local transport

•     Track travel expenses against budget

•     Share a monthly travel expense summary with Finance

***Office Administration***

•     Run the day-to-day office operations

•     Look after housekeeping, supplies, IT support and upkeep

•     Manage office vendors and service contracts

•     Prepare monthly payroll inputs for Finance

•     Handle office licences and statutory compliance

**What We Are Looking For**

•     4–5 years of experience in HR and administration

•     Experience in an SME or owner-led business is preferred

•     Working knowledge of HR processes and Indian labour compliance

•     Strong follow-up skills

•     Well organised and able to handle confidential information

•     Good communication in English and Hindi. Gujarati is a plus.

•     Comfortable with MS Office, especially Excel, Word and Outlook

•     Graduate. An MBA or diploma in HR is an advantage.

**Why Join Us**

•     Work closely with the Director

•     Own the HR and admin function of the office

•     Be part of a growing business in the international diamond trade

**How to Apply**

Send your CV to chirag@janamcorp.com. Use the subject line "HR & Admin Assistant Manager". You can also apply directly on LinkedIn.

title: Digital HR Systems Lead (Cornerstone LMS-LXP)
description:
**Do you enjoy being part of a team that drives efficiency through automation?**
**Would you like to work with a global organization?**
**Join our Global Digital HR Team**
Our Human Capital & Technology Team provides HR support for client group Leaders, Managers and Employees on organizational and employee matters. We also provide coaching, HR process expertise and other general HR activities. Individuals in this category act as the HR Director of record for a client group.
  
  
**Join our Global Digital HR Team**
Our Human Capital & Technology Team provides HR support for client group Leaders, Managers and Employees on organizational and employee matters. We also provide coaching, HR process expertise and other general HR activities. Individuals in this category act as the HR Director of record for a client group.
  
  
**Partner with the best**
As a Digital Technology Specialist - Technical Product Management, you’ll be responsible for supporting the global implementation, sustainment and optimization strategy of our Baker Hughes Learning and Competency platforms, anchored on Cornerstone LMS and LXP. The systems lead will be part of the Global Digital HR Technology team and will report into Director- Learning Technology and HR Systems
  
  
The Specialist will manage multiple concurrent projects – including Cornerstone implementation, multiple system migration data and content migration, integrations and enhancements – while providing oversight of ServiceNow support queues, case resolution and SLA adherence for the Baker Hughes Support teams.
  
  
The ideal candidate will have deep technical and functional experience with Cornerstone, learning and competency systems, and related processes within a global HR Technology landscape.
  
  
The Specialist will gather requirements, analyse problems, design and test solutions, and work with stakeholders and implementation partners to craft scalable, secure and sustainable HR Technology solutions across SSO, integrations and reporting.
  
  
The ideal candidate will have experience providing HR Technology operations support, training others in support matters, and managing ticket data and support metrics to drive incident reduction. The candidate will be comfortable in a fast-paced, global, multi-tenant environment. They will take initiative to drive performance improvement within the learning and competency ecosystem.
  
  
As a Specialist, you will be responsible for:
  
  
  

+ Cornerstone implementation: Leading Cornerstone LMS and LXP projects end-to-end – gathering requirements, fit-gap analysis, solution design, configuration, facilitating testing (SIT/UAT), cutover, go-live and hypercare
+ Migration: Planning and executing migration from legacy LMS platforms to Cornerstone, including users, organizational units, training content, curricula, certifications and learning history, with data validation and reconciliation
+ Configuration & design: Configuring, designing, building, testing, and deploying functionality in Cornerstone Learning, LXP, Competency Management systems
+ SSO & security: Owning SSO and identity setup (SAML 2.0, Azure AD/Entra ID), user provisioning, security roles, permissions, domains and constraints
+ Integrations: Designing, managing and troubleshooting integrations with HRIS (e.g., Workday), third-party content providers and downstream systems via APIs, SFTP feeds and Cornerstone Edge
+ Reporting & analytics: Designing and delivering Cornerstone custom reports, compliance dashboards and data extracts to support business, audit and leadership needs
+ Support & case management: Being the central point of support management for Baker Hughes HR Systems (Learning, Skills and Competency ecosystem) – managing ServiceNow queues, triaging, resolving and escalating cases within SLA, and maintaining knowledge articles
+ Problem solving: Solving routine end user problems as well as identifying, escalating, and performing root cause analysis for recurrent or systemic issues and designing permanent solutions
+ Project management: Managing project plans, timelines, risks, dependencies and status reporting; coordinating with Cornerstone, implementation partners and internal stakeholders
+ Release management: Assessing Cornerstone quarterly releases, performing impact analysis and regression testing, and communicating changes to stakeholders
+ Supporting Learning and Skill mapping and integration activities, and maintaining content quality with skills and related processes
+ Executing product technology and functional capability roadmaps
+ Working with relevant stakeholders to redesign business processes and improve the Learning & Competency Management experience for employees globally
+ Participating in prioritization discussions for business requirements, approving future state design/configurations and ensuring successful implementation
+ Contributing to overall business process improvements and being a catalyst for streamlined and effective processes across the global HR Technology organization
+ Working to improve incident reduction, simplification, process excellence, security, data privacy and compliance

**Fuel your passion**
To be successful in this role you will:
  
  
  

+ Have a bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, or a related field
+ Have minimum 9 years of IT or Technology experience, including 5+ years of hands-on Cornerstone OnDemand
+ Have delivered at least one full lifecycle Cornerstone LMS-LXP implementation and a large-scale migration from a legacy LMS (e.g., SumTotal, SAP SuccessFactors, Saba)
+ Be technically sound, with strong working knowledge of SSO (SAML 2.0, Azure AD/Entra ID), REST APIs, SFTP, data feeds and file formats (CSV/XML)
+ Have deep experience using Migration Utilities, Data Load Wizard / Edge Import and advanced system configuration
+ Be capable of supporting and troubleshooting complex upstream and downstream integrations (e.g., Workday HCM)
+ Have strong reporting experience with Cornerstone custom reports and analytics, along with advanced Excel skills
+ Have hands-on ServiceNow experience – incident, request and problem management, SLAs, knowledge base and queue dashboards
+ Have strong analytical, problem-solving and solution design skills, with the ability to translate business requirements into technical designs
+ Have proven experience managing multiple concurrent projects, including plans, risks, vendors and stakeholder communications
+ Have experience integrating and maintaining third party libraries ensuring end-user Catalog is in-sync with vendor-provided specifications
+ Be able to advance troubleshoot complex learning and competencies structures: Observation checklists, Competencies, and Curricula
+ Have experience in mapping of job roles, competencies, learning activities and using HR Systems, Competency Profiles and Levels of Proficiency
+ Be able to work flexible hours with Management to support the relevant countries (UK Shift Preferred)
+ Have leadership and influencing skills and be a Self-starter able to give guidance and take counsel
+ Ability to manage global stakeholders in a fast-paced environment
+ Have great organizational skills and the ability to accomplish assigned goals and work well with global team

+ Cornerstone certifications (Learning, Edge/Integrations, Reporting)
+ Experience with Workday HCM and skills platforms
+ Power BI or SQL for advanced reporting and data analysis
+ Experience working with system integrators and implementation partners in a global, multi-tenant environment

**Work in a way that works for you**
We recognize that everyone is different and that the way in which people want to work and deliver at their best is different for everyone too. In this role, we can offer the following flexible working patterns:
  
  
  

* Working flexible hours - flexing the times when you work in the day to help you fit everything in and work when you are the most productive

**Working with us**
Our people are at the heart of what we do at Baker Hughes. We know we are better when all of our people are developed, engaged and able to bring their whole authentic selves to work. We invest in the health and well-being of our workforce, train and reward talent and develop leaders at all levels to bring out the best in each other.
  
  
**Working for you**
Our inventions have revolutionized energy for over a century. But to keep going forward tomorrow, we know we have to push the boundaries today. We prioritize rewarding those who embrace change with a package that reflects how much we value their input. Join us, and you can expect:
  
  
  

* Contemporary work-life balance policies and wellbeing activities
* Comprehensive private medical care options
* Safety net of life insurance and disability programs
* Tailored financial programs
* Additional elected or voluntary benefits

The Baker Hughes internal title for this role is: Digital Technology Senior Specialist - Technical Product Management
  
  
**About Us:**
We are an energy technology company that provides solutions to energy and industrial customers worldwide. Built on a century of experience and conducting business in over 120 countries, our innovative technologies and services are taking energy forward – making it safer, cleaner and more efficient for people and the planet.
  
  
**Join Us:**
Are you seeking an opportunity to make a real difference in a company that values innovation and progress? Join us and become part of a team of people who will challenge and inspire you! Let’s come together and take energy forward.

title: Change Analyst
description:
**Company Overview**
We exist to make food the world loves. But we do more than that. Our company is a place that prioritizes being a force for good, a place to expand learning, explore new perspectives and reimagine new possibilities, every day. We look for people who want to bring their best — bold thinkers with big hearts who challenge one another and grow together. Because becoming the undisputed leader in food means surrounding ourselves with people who are hungry for what’s next.
  
  
**Job Overview**
As a Change Analyst, you will partner with the GIC Change Lead to support transformation initiatives from a change management lens. You will help bring structure, clarity, and follow-through to complex change by translating business and project needs into practical change approaches that drive adoption and measurable outcomes. You will also leverage reusable enterprise assets, tools, and practices that help make change more consistent and effective over time.
  
  
**Key Accountabilities**
**Support Transformation Initiatives**

* Partner with the GIC Change Lead to support transformation initiatives through a structured change management lens.
* Support the design and execution of change strategies, plans, and activities that drive adoption and sustain business outcomes.
* Translate business and project requirements into practical change interventions, including development of the change narrative, stakeholder analysis, change plans, and supporting resources.
* Leverage GMI’s Change Playbook, tools, templates, and reusable assets to promote consistent and effective change practices across GIC initiatives.

**Evaluate Change Impact and Readiness**

* Assess and organize change impacts across initiatives, stakeholder groups, and ways of working.
* Manage change impact data and reporting through the change dashboard to support visibility, tracking, and decision-making.
* Evaluate organizational readiness and help shape approaches that enable effective adoption of change.

**Collaborate with Project Teams**

* Coordinate with project teams, business stakeholders, and functional partners to gather inputs, align on priorities, and support execution of change activities.
* Partner with Learning and Development, Communications, Project Managers, and business leaders to activate engagement plans and drive adoption actions.
* Support the execution of change activities with a focus on quality, consistency, and business relevance.

**Sustain the rigor through continuous learning and feedback**

* Capture lessons learned and stakeholder feedback throughout initiatives, and apply insights to refine approaches and lead change with agility.
* Identify recurring themes, risks, and opportunities across the GIC change portfolio and escalate relevant insights to the Change Lead.
* Provide feedback to the CoE to support ongoing improvement of change methodologies, tools, and practices.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience in change management, business, communications, human resources, organizational psychology, or a related field.
* 2 to 4 years of experience supporting change management work on transformation, process improvement, or organizational change initiatives.
* Experience supporting core change management deliverables
* Ability to work effectively with cross-functional stakeholders at multiple levels to gather inputs, support alignment, and help execute change activities.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to synthesize information into clear, concise, leadership-ready updates/presentations.
* Strong organizational and project coordination skills, including the ability to navigate the organization and manage multiple priorities with attention to detail and follow-through.

**Preferred Qualifications**
Up to 7 years of experience supporting change management work on large-scale, cross-functional transformation initiatives in complex stakeholder environments.
  
  

* Consulting experience in change management, transformation, and/or program delivery, with the ability to:
* bring structure to ambiguity
* synthesize inputs
* turn insights into actionable recommendations
* Experience supporting change intake, prioritization, tiering, and governance processes, including maintaining intake artifacts and preparing decision-support materials.
* Experience facilitating:
* working sessions
* stakeholder discussions
* change enablement activities
* Experience leveraging reusable change assets – including playbooks, templates, tools, and reporting materials – to drive consistency, while applying the art of of change through judgement, adaptation and continuous improvement
* Change management certification, education, or formal training such as Prosci.

**ELIGIBILITY**
Applicants must meet minimum age qualifications in the country in which the job is located.

title: Senior Associate, HR Operations
description:
**Overview**
CACTUS is a remote-first organization and we embrace an accelerate from anywhere culture. You may be required to travel to our Mumbai office based on business requirements or for company/team events.
  
  
We are seeking a detail-oriented and experienced Senior Associate, Payroll and HR Operations to front end manage payroll coordination and support lifecycle HR operations for the India entity, and to provide oversight of payroll delivery across our global offices. This is not a hands-on payroll processing role — payroll is managed by an external vendor for India (and by local vendors for each global office). Instead, this role owns the accuracy, timeliness, and compliance of payroll outcomes by collating inputs, validating vendor outputs, and coordinating closely with in-country points of contact (POCs). The ideal candidate is highly organized, detail-oriented, and comfortable managing vendors and cross-border stakeholders to ensure nothing falls through the cracks.
  
  
**Please note: We are looking only for external candidates and not accepting any internal applications for this position at the moment.**
**Responsibilities**

* Manage end-to-end India payroll coordination with external vendors, including monthly payroll inputs, validation, payroll calendars, salary disbursement, and resolution of discrepancies.
* Coordinate statutory payroll compliance across applicable states, including PF, ESI, Professional Tax, LWF, and TDS, while tracking filing timelines and supporting Form 16 issuance and TDS reconciliations.
* Manage employee exit-related payroll activities, including full & final settlements, gratuity calculations, leave encashment, and coordination with payroll vendors.
* Oversee global payroll coordination across multiple locations by working with regional POCs and in-country vendors to ensure accurate and timely payroll processing and compliance.
* Maintain accurate HRIS and employee master data and ensure timely processing and communication of employee lifecycle changes, including new hires, exits, transfers, promotions, and compensation changes.
* Act as the primary point of contact for payroll-related employee queries and support internal and external payroll audits, compliance checks, and vendor SLA reviews.
* Drive payroll process improvements through accurate trackers and dashboards, SOP documentation, vendor management, and initiatives to improve payroll accuracy, timeliness, and operational efficiency.

**Qualifications And Prerequisites**

* Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Commerce, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
* 3–5+ years of experience in payroll operations, payroll coordination, and generalist HR operations, preferably with exposure to vendor-managed or outsourced payroll models.
* Strong working knowledge of Indian statutory compliance, including PF, ESI, PT, LWF, and TDS, with the ability to review and validate vendor payroll outputs and filings.
* Proven experience managing external vendors, tracking SLAs and deadlines, and coordinating with stakeholders across different time zones and geographies.
* Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including VLOOKUP, pivot tables, and other data management and analysis functions.
* High level of accuracy, confidentiality, discretion, and organizational skills, with the ability to manage sensitive employee data and multiple priorities simultaneously.
* Prior experience with multi-country payroll, HRIS platforms, vendor management or procurement, and familiarity with the Indian Labour Codes and their impact on payroll and compliance will be an added advantage.

Application Process
  
  
Before applying, please ensure you meet the role requirements listed above and have legal authorization to work in the country where this role is advertised. Our selection process typically involves an initial screening by a recruiter, a technical assessment, and two to three interview rounds.
  
  
**Equal Opportunity**
Our hiring practices reflect our commitment to providing equal opportunities and creating an environment where everyone can thrive, develop, and succeed. We celebrate the uniqueness of our team members and prohibit discrimination of any kind, based on race, color, religion, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, or any other protected characteristic.
  
  
**Accelerating from Anywhere**
As a remote-first organization, these are essential attributes we look for in all our candidates.
  
  

* Taking ownership of your work with minimal supervision, showing strong ability to organize, prioritize and deliver results independently.
* Documenting work that brings everyone on the same page.
* Maturity to choose between synchronous and asynchronous collaboration.
* Effectively collaborating with colleagues across different time zones by setting dedicated hours for collaboration and keeping team members updated through your MS Teams status.

**About CACTUS**
Established in 2002, Cactus Communications (cactusglobal.com) is a leading technology company that specializes in expert services and AI-driven products which improve how research gets funded, published, communicated, and discovered. Its flagship brand Editage offers a comprehensive suite of researcher solutions, including expert services and cutting-edge AI products like Mind the Graph, Paperpal, and R Discovery. With offices in Princeton, London, Singapore, Beijing, Shanghai, Seoul, Tokyo, and Mumbai and a global workforce of over 3,000 experts, CACTUS is a pioneer in workplace best practices and has been consistently recognized as a great place to work.

title: HR Manager – Manpower, Recruitment & Compliance
description:
**About the Company**

We are a well-established shipping and marine services company headquartered in Mumbai, with operations primarily along the West Coast of India and plans to expand our geographical presence in due course.

The company is committed to providing a professional and supportive work environment, with a strong emphasis on sound HR practices, employee welfare and systematic processes.

**Role Overview**

We are looking for an experienced, hands-on HR Manager to manage the company's manpower requirements and HR operations through robust processes, effective recruitment systems and disciplined data management.

Our shore-based operations are expected to require approximately 150 personnel on permanent or contractual employment. Considering contractual staff rotation, replacements and recurring recruitment requirements, the HR department will need to manage a manpower pool of approximately 300–400 personnel.

The role will therefore have a strong focus on 
**contract, semi-blue-collar and white-collar manpower management**
, with particular emphasis on recruitment, contracting, deployment, monitoring, retention and statutory compliance.

The successful candidate should be comfortable managing both the people-related and administrative aspects of HR, ensuring uninterrupted manpower availability, accurate records and compliance with applicable regulations.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**1. Recruitment & Manpower Sourcing**

* Identify, develop and maintain a database of multiple reliable recruitment sources, manpower contractors and labour suppliers to ensure a continuous supply of suitable personnel.
* Manage end-to-end recruitment, including candidate sourcing, screening, interviews, verification, documentation and onboarding.
* Recruit personnel across marine operations, shore-based operations and support functions.
* Build a dependable talent pipeline to meet recurring manpower requirements and facilitate timely replacement of personnel at the end of contractual assignments.
* Maintain recruitment records and monitor hiring timelines to ensure operational requirements are met without delays.

**2. Contract, Semi-Blue-Collar & White-Collar Manpower Management**

* Demonstrate hands-on experience in sourcing, contracting, deploying and monitoring contract and semi-blue-collar manpower, as well as managing white-collar personnel.
* Manage the recruitment, deployment, attendance, documentation and continuity of personnel across various operational and support functions.
* Maintain accurate and updated records for personnel, including:
* Mooring crew
* Radio Officers
* Drivers
* Guesthouse cooks and other support staff
* Other shore-based operational and administrative personnel
* Coordinate with contractors, labour suppliers and internal operations teams to ensure adequate manpower availability and timely deployment.
* Monitor contract periods, staff rotation, replacements and renewals to ensure continuity of services.
* Address manpower shortages, absenteeism, employee grievances and contractor-related issues promptly.
* Support employee retention through effective coordination, timely resolution of workplace issues and implementation of sound HR practices.

**3. Government & Statutory Compliance**

* Track changes in government regulations, labour laws and statutory requirements applicable to the company and its contractual workforce.
* Ensure that all applicable registrations, licences, statutory records, audit documentation and other compliance-related documents are maintained, updated and readily accessible.
* Coordinate with labour consultants, statutory compliance agencies and external advisors to ensure adherence to applicable requirements.
* Ensure contractual manpower arrangements, employment documentation and contractor practices comply with relevant regulations.
* Proactively identify potential compliance gaps, initiate corrective action and monitor closure within stipulated timelines.
* Establish systems for tracking compliance deadlines, document renewals, inspections and audit requirements.

**4. HR Processes, Data Management & Reporting**

* Establish and maintain systematic HR processes, standard operating procedures and documentation practices.
* Ensure accurate, centralised and easily retrievable records for permanent employees, contractual personnel and manpower suppliers.
* Maintain databases covering employee details, employment contracts, joining and exit dates, attendance, qualifications, certifications and other relevant records.
* Introduce effective systems to track contract expiries, personnel replacements, document validity and pending compliance requirements.
* Prepare periodic reports on manpower strength, recruitment, attrition, contract renewals and compliance status.
* Streamline existing HR records and processes to improve accuracy, transparency and operational efficiency.

**5. Coordination & Administration**

* Work closely with operations teams to anticipate manpower requirements and plan recruitment and deployment accordingly.
* Coordinate with clients, contractors, consultants and other external stakeholders on personnel documentation and manpower-related requirements.
* Liaise with insurance providers on relevant employee and contractual workforce insurance matters.
* Coordinate crew and staff travel, joining arrangements and other personnel logistics, wherever required.
* Ensure timely communication and effective coordination between HR, operations and management.

**Industry:**

Shipping & Marine Services

**Experience:**

Experienced HR professional with a strong background in contract manpower management, recruitment and statutory compliance

**Candidate Profile**

* Relevant experience in HR management, recruitment, contract labour management and statutory compliance.
* **Demonstrated hands-on experience managing contract and semi-blue-collar manpower is essential.**
* Experience handling a sizeable workforce involving contractual appointments, rotations, replacements and recurring recruitment.
* Good working knowledge of applicable labour laws, statutory compliance and manpower contracting practices.
* Strong skills in recruitment sourcing, vendor coordination, employee documentation and HR process management.
* Proficiency in MS Excel and other digital tools for employee databases, reporting and record management.
* Ability to independently manage multiple priorities, resolve manpower-related issues and coordinate with diverse stakeholders.
* A practical, organised and solution-oriented approach, with high standards of integrity and confidentiality.
* Experience in shipping, maritime, logistics, infrastructure or industrial services will be an advantage.

**What We Offer**

* An opportunity to work with an established shipping and marine services organisation.
* A professional and supportive work environment.
* An organisation that values sound HR practices, employee welfare and structured processes.
* Scope to build and strengthen HR systems as the company expands its operations.

**The ideal candidate will be a hands-on HR professional who can combine effective manpower sourcing and management with strong compliance practices, systematic data management and a commitment to maintaining a reliable and well-managed workforce.**

description:

Manager - HRBP

**What’s the purpose of this role?**

The purpose of this role is to actively drive and contribute to the business growth by smooth end to end life cycle management of employees, on-boarding, and integrate them with all HR practices well. As an HR Generalist, the role is expected to deliver high impact people programs, policies, practices (like recruitment, development, engagement, performance management, cultural pillars and other frameworks) through business and employee partnering. **Key Results and Activities**

1)
**HR Operation Lead:**
Ensure smooth, accurate, timely and employee-centric delivery of HR operations across the employee lifecycle. Drive standardized HR processes, HR systems, documentation, policies, compliance and employee services while partnering with HRBPs, Finance, managers and employees to provide a seamless employee experience and reliable HR data for business decision-making.

a.
**Employee Lifecycle Management -**
Manage and ensure seamless execution of HR processes across the employee lifecycle, including joining, onboarding, transfers, promotions, confirmations, role/designation changes, employee movements and exits.

b.

Ensure accurate and timely maintenance of employee records, personnel files, HR documentation, letters, agreements and other employee-related records in accordance with organizational processes and statutory requirements.

c
**. HRIS & Employee Data Management -**
Maintain accurate employee data in HR systems and ensure timely updates related to employee movements, attendance, leave, organizational changes and other HR transactions. Continuously improve HR systems and processes to enhance efficiency and employee experience.

d.
**Payroll & Benefits Coordination -**
Partner with Finance and relevant stakeholders to ensure accurate and timely payroll inputs, attendance, leave, reimbursements, deductions, statutory contributions and employee benefit administration. Resolve payroll and benefits-related employee queries within defined timelines.

e.
**Attendance & Leave Administration -**
Administer attendance, leave and related HR processes, ensuring adherence to organizational policies. Monitor exceptions, identify recurring issues and work with managers and employees to ensure appropriate resolution.

f.
**HR Policies & Process Deployment -**
Support the development, implementation and continuous improvement of HR policies, SOPs and processes. Ensure policies are effectively communicated, understood and consistently implemented across the organization.

g.
**Statutory Compliance & HR Compliance**
- Coordinate with internal and external stakeholders to ensure compliance with applicable labour laws, statutory requirements and organizational policies. Maintain required records, documentation and compliance reports and support audits whenever required.

h.
**Employee Query & HR Service Delivery -**
Act as a first point of contact for employees on HR operational matters. Respond to queries related to policies, payroll, leave, benefits, documentation and other employee lifecycle processes, ensuring timely resolution and a positive employee experience.

i.
**Joining, Induction & Onboarding Operations -**
Coordinate the operational aspects of joining and onboarding, including documentation, HR system creation, policy communication, benefits orientation, induction coordination and ensuring new employees are enabled to start effectively.

j.
**Exit & Full and Final Settlement -**
Manage the operational aspects of employee exits, including resignation documentation, clearance, exit formalities, full and final settlement coordination, recovery, relieving/experience documentation and timely closure of all exit-related activities.

k.
**HR MIS & Analytics**
Maintain accurate HR dashboards, MIS and reports covering headcount, attrition, hiring, employee movements, attendance, leave, payroll and other HR metrics. Provide timely and reliable data to support management decision-making.

l.
**Process Improvement & Automation**
Identify opportunities to simplify, standardize and automate HR processes. Drive improvements in turnaround time, accuracy, employee experience and overall efficiency of HR service delivery.

m.
**Employee Experience & HR Governance -**
Ensure that HR processes are delivered consistently and professionally across the organization. Monitor employee feedback and operational pain points and work with HRBPs and functional stakeholders to improve the overall employee experience.

n.
**Vendor & Stakeholder Management -**
Coordinate with external HR vendors, consultants, payroll partners, insurance/benefit providers and statutory agencies as required. Ensure timely service delivery, issue resolution and adherence to agreed processes.

o.
**HR Audit & Process Controls**
Ensure appropriate checks and controls are in place across HR processes. Conduct periodic audits of employee data, documentation and HR transactions to identify gaps and ensure process compliance.

title: Lead HR Service Delivery
description:
PI Industries is seeking an experienced leader to manage and strengthen employee lifecycle service delivery across its global operations.

The role supports approximately 4,500 employees across nine countries, with significant operations in India, the USA, Mexico and Brazil. It requires the ability to manage diverse country’s requirements while establishing consistent service standards and employee experience.

The successful candidate will bring experience in both building and running HR shared services or employee lifecycle operations. The mandate combines three priorities: delivering reliable services, expanding service delivery capabilities, and continuously improving operations through process simplification, technology and automation.

Key Accountabilities

1. Run | Global Service Delivery

**Primary accountability: Reliable, consistent and compliant employee lifecycle services across geographies.**

* Lead end-to-end employee lifecycle service delivery, including onboarding, employee transactions, employee records, offboarding and employee service requests.
* Ensure timely, accurate and consistent delivery against agreed service standards, accommodating country-specific operational and regulatory requirements.
* Establish clear service ownership, performance measures, operational controls and escalation mechanisms.
* Manage service delivery performance, operational risks, service continuity and resolution of recurring issues.
* Provide leadership and governance oversight to the Global Payroll Lead, ensuring effective payroll service delivery, controls and employee lifecycle interfaces.
* Ensure compliance with approved employment policies and operational requirements, working with HR Risk, Compliance and specialist teams.
* Lead and develop the Service Delivery team, strengthening operational capability, accountability and service orientation.
* Manage service providers and work closely with country HR teams, HRBPs, Centres of Excellence and enabling functions to ensure effective service delivery.

2. Build | Service Catalogue and Delivery Capability

**Primary accountability: Establish and expand service delivery capabilities and transition new services into sustainable operations.**

* Operationalise new and expanded employee lifecycle services within the approved service catalogue.
* Lead service transitions from design and implementation into stable operational delivery.
* Establish operating processes, service standards, ownership, controls and performance measures for newly introduced services.
* Assess operational readiness across people, processes, technology and stakeholder dependencies.
* Drive change management and adoption of new services, processes and employee/manager service channels.
* Build team capability and operating practices that support consistent service delivery across geographies.

3. Improve | Service Excellence, Technology and Employee Experience

**Primary accountability: Improve service quality, efficiency and employee experience through data-led decisions, process improvements and technology.**

* Identify opportunities to simplify processes, reduce manual intervention, eliminate recurring errors and improve service responsiveness.
* Use service performance data, reporting and analytics to identify trends, operational risks and improvement opportunities.
* Define business requirements and priorities for workflow, automation, self-service and employee service-management improvements.
* Partner with HR Systems and IT teams to implement approved technology-enabled improvements.
* Identify opportunities to apply automation and AI-enabled solutions to improve service efficiency, accuracy and employee experience.
* Drive adoption of improved processes and service channels among employees, managers and HR stakeholders.
* Monitor the effectiveness of improvements through measurable service outcomes.

Expected Outcomes

* Reliable and consistent employee lifecycle service delivery across countries.
* An operational service catalogue with clear ownership, standards and performance measures.
* Successful transition and stabilisation of new services within the delivery model.
* Measurable reduction in manual effort, recurring errors, rework and avoidable escalations.
* Improved employee and manager service experience.
* Effective operational controls, payroll governance and service-provider performance.

Education and Experience

Education

* Postgraduate qualification in Human Resources, Operations Management or a related management discipline.

Professional Experience

* Approximately 15–20 years of experience in HR operations, employee lifecycle service delivery or HR shared services.
* Proven experience leading multi-country employee lifecycle service operations, including managing country-specific requirements.
* Demonstrated experience establishing, expanding or transitioning HR services into stable operational delivery.
* Experience managing service performance, operational controls, cross-functional dependencies and service improvement initiatives.
* Experience leading teams and working with senior stakeholders across geographies.
* Experience managing process improvement, change management and technology-enabled service delivery initiatives.

Technology, Data and Automation

* **HR Technology:**
  Proficiency in SAP SuccessFactors, with practical experience using the platform to manage employee lifecycle processes, data and service delivery. Exposure to other global HR ERP/HCM platforms is an advantage.
* **Reporting and Analytics:**
  Working experience in HR data reporting and analytics, including the ability to interpret operational data, identify trends and use insights to improve service performance.
* **Automation:**
  Working knowledge of workflow, process automation and employee self-service technologies, with experience identifying and implementing service improvements.
* **Artificial Intelligence:**
  Practical exposure to AI-enabled applications or initiatives in HR operations, service delivery or process improvement.

Leadership Capabilities

* Strong operational leadership and accountability for service outcomes.
* Ability to build new service capabilities while managing ongoing operations.
* Structured problem-solving and sound operational judgement.
* Effective people leadership, coaching and team development.
* Ability to influence and collaborate across functions and geographies.
* Strong service orientation and commitment to employee and manager experience.
* Comfort with technology, data and continuous improvement

title: Human Resource Consultant
description:
**Job Description: HR Consultant**

**Company:**

GetStructured

**Location:**

Mumbai

**Work Mode:**

Work from Office / Client Visits, as required

**Employment Type:**

Full-time

**Experience:**

4–7 years

**About GetStructured**

GetStructured is an HR consulting and fractional HR practice that helps growing businesses build, structure and strengthen their HR functions. We partner with founders and leadership teams to create effective people practices, streamline HR operations, improve employee experience and establish scalable HR systems.

Our work spans the entire employee lifecycle, from recruitment and onboarding to performance management, employee engagement, HR policies, compliance and strategic HR advisory.

**Role Overview**

We are looking for an experienced and hands-on
**HR Consultant**

who can work closely with founders, business leaders and client teams to understand their business requirements and implement practical HR solutions.

This role combines strategic HR advisory with hands-on execution. The ideal candidate should be comfortable managing multiple client engagements, building HR processes from the ground up, advising leadership teams and ensuring effective implementation of HR initiatives.

**Key Responsibilities**
**1. HR Business Partnering & Client Management**

* Act as a trusted HR partner to founders, business leaders and client management teams.
* Understand business objectives and translate them into practical HR strategies and initiatives.
* Manage multiple client engagements and ensure timely delivery of agreed HR services.
* Conduct periodic client reviews, identify people-related challenges and recommend actionable solutions.
* Build strong client relationships and maintain effective stakeholder communication.

**2. HR Operations & Process Implementation**

* Set up and streamline HR processes for growing businesses, including onboarding, employee documentation, attendance, leave management and exit formalities.
* Develop and implement HR policies, employee handbooks, SOPs and internal guidelines.
* Support payroll coordination, employee records, HR MIS and monthly reporting.
* Identify process gaps and recommend improvements to enhance operational efficiency.

**3. Performance Management & Organisation Development**

* Design and implement KRAs, KPIs, OKRs and performance appraisal frameworks.
* Support goal-setting, performance reviews, feedback mechanisms and performance improvement plans.
* Assist clients with organisation structuring, role clarity, job descriptions and reporting frameworks.
* Advise managers on employee productivity, team effectiveness and performance-related concerns.

**4. Employee Relations & Engagement**

* Handle employee grievances, conflict resolution and disciplinary matters with professionalism.
* Design and implement employee engagement, recognition and retention initiatives.
* Support managers in addressing performance, behavioural and workplace concerns.
* Improve employee experience across the employee lifecycle.

**5. Recruitment & Talent Management**

* Partner with clients to understand manpower requirements and workforce planning needs.
* Support recruitment strategy, job descriptions, interview processes and candidate evaluation.
* Coordinate with recruitment teams and hiring managers to improve hiring effectiveness.
* Assist with onboarding, talent development, succession planning and retention initiatives.

**6. HR Compliance & Advisory**

* Support the implementation and periodic review of HR policies and statutory compliance requirements.
* Assist with POSH-related processes, awareness initiatives and policy documentation.
* Identify HR compliance gaps and prepare recommendations and action plans.
* Coordinate with relevant specialists where legal or technical expertise is required.

**7. HR Consulting & Project Delivery**

* Conduct HR audits and process reviews to identify gaps in existing HR practices.
* Develop structured implementation roadmaps and track progress against agreed deliverables.
* Prepare client presentations, HR reports, dashboards and management updates.
* Support the implementation of HR technology and HRMS solutions based on client requirements.
* Contribute to the development of standardised HR frameworks, templates and consulting methodologies at GetStructured.

**Desired Candidate Profile**

* 4–7 years of relevant experience in HR business partnering, HR consulting, HR generalist or HR operations roles.
* MBA / PGDM in Human Resources or a relevant postgraduate qualification preferred.
* Strong understanding of the complete employee lifecycle and core HR processes.
* Experience in working with startups, SMEs or growing businesses will be an advantage.
* Ability to independently manage stakeholders and execute HR projects from inception to implementation.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication and presentation skills.
* Excellent documentation, process management and report-writing abilities.
* Comfortable working in a dynamic consulting environment with multiple clients and competing priorities.
* Proficiency in MS Excel, PowerPoint and HRMS platforms.

**Key Competencies**

* Business acumen and a solution-oriented mindset
* Stakeholder management and influencing skills
* Ownership, accountability and attention to detail
* Structured thinking and process orientation
* Adaptability and comfort with ambiguity
* Client servicing and relationship management
* Ability to balance strategic thinking with hands-on execution

**What We Offer**

* Opportunity to work closely with founders and leadership teams across diverse businesses.
* Exposure to varied industries, business challenges and HR transformation projects.
* An opportunity to build and implement HR functions rather than simply maintain existing processes.
* A collaborative environment with opportunities to deepen HR consulting and strategic partnering capabilities.
* Meaningful ownership of client engagements and professional growth.

title: Lead Inclusion, Culture & Ethics
description:

**Job ID:**
90648**

**Join us as a**
Lead Inclusion, Culture & Ethics
  
  
**Your Main Responsibilities**
**Role Summary:**
Drive an inclusive, respectful, and values-led workplace culture by embedding diversity, equity, inclusion, ethical conduct, employee voice mechanisms, and statutory compliance frameworks across the organization.
  
  
**Roles & Responsibilities:**

* Inclusion and Diversity

Design and implement initiatives that foster an inclusive, equitable, and respectful workplace.
  
  
Partner with HR Business Partners and business leaders to integrate inclusion principles into relevant work & HR processes.
  
  
Monitor diversity metrics, identify gaps, and recommend action plans to improve representation and inclusion outcomes.
  
  
Lead employee resource groups (ERGs) and inclusion champions networks.
  
  
Drive awareness campaigns, observance of diversity calendars, and organization-wide inclusion programs.
  
  
Measure employee sentiment on inclusion and belonging through surveys, focus groups, and other feedback mechanisms.
  
  

* Culture Transformation, Employee Experience and Employer Branding

Champion the organization's values and translate them into tangible employee behaviors and practices.
  
  
Design and implement culture-building interventions that strengthen employee engagement and organizational effectiveness.
  
  
Partner with leaders to enhance culture, team effectiveness, collaboration, and psychological safety.
  
  
Analyze employee feedback and engagement data to identify cultural strengths, risks, and improvement opportunities.
  
  
Develop and implement action plans to improve employee experience and workplace culture.
  
  
Act as a trusted advisor to leaders on culture-related challenges and change management initiatives.
  
  
Manage the organization's employer brand presence across external platforms including LinkedIn, Glassdoor, Ambition Box, Indeed, and other relevant channels.
  
  
Monitor employer brand metrics, candidate feedback, and external reputation indicators, recommending actions to strengthen the organization's position as an employer of choice.
  
  
Drive participation in employer branding awards, external benchmarking studies, and best workplace certifications to enhance organizational visibility and market reputation.
  
  

* Employee Grievance Management

Own and manage the organization's grievance redressal framework and mechanisms.
  
  
Review, investigate, and resolve employee complaints in a fair, confidential, and timely manner.
  
  
Conduct fact-finding investigations and recommend appropriate resolutions based on policy and organizational values.
  
  
Track grievance trends, identify systemic issues, and recommend preventive interventions.
  
  
Partner with HR, Legal, and business leaders to ensure consistency and fairness in grievance resolution.
  
  
Maintain confidential records and documentation in line with legal and organizational requirements.
  
  
Build employee confidence in speaking-up and escalation mechanisms.
  
  

* Ethics & Ant-discrimination

Lead ethics communication, training, and awareness programs for employees and managers.
  
  
Manage ethics-related complaints, conduct investigations, and coordinate resolution processes.
  
  
Monitor ethics trends and recommend actions to strengthen ethical culture and risk mitigation.
  
  

* POSH (Prevention of Sexual Harassment) Compliance

Serve as the HR custodian for POSH compliance in line with applicable legislation.
  
  
Support and coordinate the Internal Committee (IC) and ensure effective case management.
  
  
Ensure timely and compliant handling of POSH complaints, investigations, and documentation.
  
  
Facilitate POSH awareness, sensitization, and certification programs across employee groups.
  
  
Maintain all statutory records and ensure compliance with annual reporting requirements.
  
  
Review organizational practices and recommend improvements to strengthen workplace safety and respect.
  
  
Provide guidance to managers and employees on POSH-related concerns while maintaining confidentiality and procedural fairness.
  
  

* Governance, Analytics & Reporting

Develop dashboards and reports on inclusion, culture, grievances, ethics, and POSH metrics.
  
  
Track key indicators such as diversity metrics, grievance resolution timelines and ethics cases, I&D compliance module completions.
  
  
Present insights and recommendations to HR leadership and senior management.
  
  
Benchmark external best practices and recommend enhancements to organizational programs.
  
  
**What You Bring**
**Qualification, Experience & Skills:**
**Qualification:**
Master’s degree in human resources, Organizational Psychology, Business Administration, Social Sciences, or a related field.
  
  
Certification or specialized training in Diversity, Equity & Inclusion (DEI), Employee Relations, POSH, Ethics & Compliance, or Employee Experience would be preferred.
  
  
Certified POSH Trainer/Investigator or experience supporting Internal Committees will be an added advantage.
  
  
**Professional Experience:**
8+ years of progressive HR experience, with significant exposure to Inclusion & Diversity, Culture Transformation, Employee Experience, Employee Relations, and Compliance.
  
  
Proven experience in designing and implementing DEI, culture, engagement, and employer branding initiatives.
  
  
Demonstrated experience in handling employee grievances, workplace investigations, ethics cases, and sensitive employee relations matters.
  
  
Strong understanding of POSH legislation and practical experience supporting complaint management, investigations, and compliance reporting.
  
  
**Skills Required for the Job:**
Excellent stakeholder management, communication, influencing, facilitation, and conflict resolution skills.
  
  
Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities, with the ability to translate employee insights into actionable interventions.
  
  
High levels of integrity, empathy, and judgment, with the ability to drive a culture of trust, inclusion, accountability, and compliance.
  
  
**What’s in it for you?**

* Join our purpose-driven organization. Help shape an industry in which two billion people rely on our products and services every day.
* Your development matters to us. We help you grow by offering the support you need to develop your skills and access a rewarding and fulfilling career.
* Thrive in a diverse and supportive culture. Through local and global initiatives, we promote a culture of inclusion which celebrates diversity and ensures that everyone feels valued.

**We Elevate… Your Career**
Become part of our team, help us enhance quality of life and drive innovation while raising the bar for safety and sustainability. We value your diverse skills and perspectives as together we shape the sustainable cities of today and tomorrow.

* Existing HR systems are stable, well-governed, and effectively utilized.

title: Human Resources Manager
description:
**Why do we exist? What do we do?**

The quality of school education available to students from low-income communities across India is abysmal. Their chances of attending college or building a career are significantly lower than their high-income peers, condemning them to a life without voice or choice. iTeach was born in 2015 to challenge this status quo and create a level playing field for ALL children.

We run free and high-impact schools and an exceptional college-to-career program for the most disadvantaged students in Pune and Navi Mumbai. We are known for our world-class professional development, our result-oriented team culture, and our student-centric school design. Read more about us at www.iTeachSchools.org.

**Responsibilities**

iTeach is scaling — from a 500-person organisation today to 1,000+ over the next five years. That's not just a headcount number. It means new schools, new cities, new layers of leadership, and thousands more students getting a real shot at a different life. It also means the systems, culture, and people practices that got us here need to be rebuilt for where we're going.

This is where you come in.

iTeach's founding belief is "first who, then what" — we bet everything on our people. Get their experience right, every day, every year, and everything else follows. The HR Lead sits at the centre of that bet: you'll be the person leadership turns to for a real-time pulse on the health of the organisation, the architect of the systems that let us scale without losing what makes iTeach
*iTeach*
, and a builder of people-management muscle across every team.

You'll work as part of the Network Team's People Ops function, partnering closely with People Ops leadership on three fronts: designing a genuinely great staff experience, owning the policies, processes, and systems that keep the organisation running smoothly, and building people-management capacity across the org — from first-time managers to school leaders.

**Be the pulse of the organisation**

* Own how leadership sees organisational health — through regular staff check-ins, early-warning signals on brewing issues, and a sharp eye for helping leaders spot emerging talent as fast as emerging problems.
* Track and report on the metrics that matter — attrition, engagement, and other leading indicators — so leadership always has a real, current read on how the org is actually doing
* Turn what you see into action, not just dashboards.

**Build the systems for 500 → 1,000**

* Revamp the HR systems, tools, and processes that need to hold up at double our current size — leave tracking, punctuality, payroll, and beyond — designed for great user experience, easy review, and powerful analytics.
* Study trends across teams and locations and get ahead of the policy and system shifts we'll need before we need them.
* Design, refine, and future-proof our HR, Promotion, and related policies so they stay sharp, relevant, and fully compliant as we grow.
* Partner with managers across the org to work through underperformance, code-of-conduct issues, extended leaves, and similar situations with clarity and care.

**Champion engagement and well-being**

* Design and run programs that make iTeach a genuinely great place to work.
* Own staff engagement measurement using structured frameworks.
* Review and benchmark staff benefits so we stay competitive as we scale.

**Lead the team**

* Lead and grow a team of 5-6 HR Associates, setting the direction, standards, and support they need to deliver on everything below.
* Build long-term plans for the team — a clear vision, concrete goals, and a growth path for each Associate — so the team scales in capability, not just headcount.

**Prerequisites**

* Required: 5+ years of work experience overall, with 2 + years leading a team
* Required: Experience in People/ HR verticals
* Preferred: Experience in a school system/education organisation

**Compensation and Benefits:**
We take pride in offering competitive compensation and benefits commensurate with the candidate's education and work experience. The salary range for this position ranges from 9.0 - 10.5 LPA CTC, and we are dedicated to providing top-notch industry benefits. These benefits include PF, gratuity, medical insurance (up to 3 lakh PA), paid leaves, annual increments, and promotion opportunities.

description:
**We're Hiring for Intralink – A Global Business Development Consultancy**

We are excited to be recruiting on behalf of Intralink, an international business development and innovation consultancy that specializes in helping companies expand into global markets. With over 36 years of experience and a presence in more than 28 locations across Asia, Europe, and North America, Intralink partners with startups, scaleups, multinationals, and government agencies to drive international growth, innovation, and sustainability.

Intralink has been recognized with prestigious awards, including the UK's King's Award for Enterprise and the US President's E Award, for its exceptional work in facilitating international business expansion.

**Finance & HR Manager, Intralink India**

**Background**

Are you someone who enjoys bringing structure, clarity and financial discipline to a fast-moving, international work environment?

Do you thrive at the intersection of finance and people operations?

And, do you want to play a pivotal role in supporting a globally connected consulting firm as it grows its footprint in India?

If that’s yes, yes and yes, you may be who we are looking for to join our team.

Intralink is a global business development consultancy specialising in international markets. With over 25 offices worldwide and more than 200 multilingual professionals, we support companies across technology, industrial, consumer and sustainability-driven sectors to expand internationally.

As we continue to grow our India presence, we are looking for a Finance & HR Manager to take ownership of the India office’s financial operations, HR administration and broader office management. You’ll report directly to the India Managing Director and work closely with our UK headquarters, playing a trusted role in ensuring smooth, compliant and efficient operations on the ground.

**What you’ll be doing**

You’ll be responsible for managing the financial health and HR operations of Intralink’s India office.

Acting as a key point of contact between local operations and UK headquarters, you’ll ensure robust financial controls, accurate reporting, and seamless coordination with external partners.

**Accounting & Finance**

In your day-to-day, you’ll manage daily bank operations, oversee staff expense claims and reimbursements, and monitor expenditure against approved budgets. You’ll prepare and report monthly management accounts to headquarters, support annual budgeting and quarterly forecasting, and provide sound financial advice to the India Managing Director.

You’ll coordinate closely with vendors, external accountants and auditors on GST, manage corporate income tax filings and statutory audits, assist in implementing standard accounting policies, and ensure all financial records are properly maintained. You’ll also manage locally issued client invoices, credit control processes, and staff severance and pension arrangements where applicable.

**HR & Payroll Support**

You’ll support core HR operations including payroll processing, withholding tax filings and year-end tax settlements. This will include assisting with staff onboarding and offboarding, benefits enrolment, annual health insurance renewals and responding to employee queries related to salaries and administrative matters.

You’ll maintain accurate personnel and leave records, support recruitment-related logistics such as interviews or job fairs when required, provide documentation for staff visas, and organise mandatory annual training or health check-ups. Ensuring HR compliance and supporting ad-hoc people-related initiatives will also form part of your role.

You’ll also stay aware of changes to Indian labour laws to ensure ongoing compliance and help organise board meetings on a quarterly basis.

**What you’ll be getting**

● Competitive and negotiable salary, depending on experience

● 20 days of paid annual leave per year

● Health insurance coverage

● A multinational working environment with close collaboration across global offices

● Exposure to international business operations and senior stakeholders

● A trusted, high-impact role supporting leadership and business growth in India

**What you’ll need**

• 5+ years of relevant work experience in accounting or finance, strongly preferred

• Hands-on experience with accounting systems (NetSuite experience highly desirable)

• Strong knowledge of accounting principles, financial controls and administrative procedures

• Solid understanding of office management systems and HR administration

• Excellent organisational, planning and multitasking skills, with strong attention to detail

• Ability to prioritise effectively and work independently in a fast-paced environment

• Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint)

• Advanced spoken and written English skills

• Native or fluent Hindi

This position is based in India (Mumbai, Delhi and Bangalore) and will require regular interaction with Intralink’s UK headquarters and local stakeholders.

Please submit a CV and Cover Letter detailing your experience and motivations for applying to this role.

title: Manager, Learning & Development
description:
**Company Overview**
We exist to make food the world loves. But we do more than that. Our company is a place that prioritizes being a force for good, a place to expand learning, explore new perspectives and reimagine new possibilities, every day. We look for people who want to bring their best — bold thinkers with big hearts who challenge one another and grow together. Because becoming the undisputed leader in food means surrounding ourselves with people who are hungry for what’s next.
  
  
**Job Overview**
The Learning & Development Manager is the learning business partner for the Global India Center (GIC). The role works with business leaders and HRBPs to understand learning needs, and then plans, coordinates and runs the learning programs that meet them at a GIC level.
  
  
The role is function-agnostic, covering leadership and professional development, core enterprise capabilities, and skills that support the GIC as it grows. The focus is on getting learning delivered well, on time, with strong participation and clear evidence of what it achieved.
  
  
**Key Accountabilities**
**Business Partnering**

* Work with business leaders and HRBPs to understand team-level learning needs and translate them into specific program requirements.
* Run regular check-ins with stakeholder groups to keep the learning plan current and gather feedback on what is working.
* Act as the single point of contact for the business on learning requests, timelines and escalations.

**Program Planning and Coordination**

* Propose and execute the annual learning plan for the GIC, including priorities, sequencing and resourcing, for sign-off by the Head of Learning, Change and Comms.
* Manage the learning budget, track spend against plan, and flag variances.
* Coordinate nominations, scheduling, logistics, venues and facilitator bookings across programs.

**Solution Build and Delivery**

* Work with Learning Architects and the global Learning COE to adapt enterprise learning journeys and academies for the GIC.
* Contract and manage SMEs, vendors and external facilitators, including scoping, quality checks and performance reviews.
* Facilitate or co-facilitate sessions where required.
* Make sure learning is practical and usable in the flow of work, using digital, AI-enabled and blended formats where they fit.

**Rollout and Adoption**

* Run the rollout of learning programs across the GIC, including nomination drives, manager briefings and reminders.
* Partner with the Internal Communications team on campaign plans and messaging for each program.
* Track attendance and completion, follow up on drop-offs, and keep leaders informed on their teams' participation.

**LMS, Data and Reporting**

* Own the content governance framework for the Learning Management System (LMS), keeping materials accurate, current and aligned to enterprise standards.
* Maintain learning dashboards and produce regular reporting on participation, completion, feedback scores and cost.
* Review the data to spot what needs fixing, and act on it.
* Write up impact stories and case studies that show what programs delivered.

**Team and Ways of Working**

* Manage and develop the Learning Operations team member, setting clear priorities, standards and development goals.
* Keep processes, templates and documentation in good order so delivery is consistent and repeatable.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATION
  
  

* 10 to 12 years of experience in Learning, Talent Development or HR, with hands-on program delivery experience
* Strong background in leadership development and enterprise capability building
* Demonstrated ability to influence senior leaders and drive alignment across stakeholders
* Track record of planning and running learning programs end to end, at scale
* Experience managing vendors, facilitators and budgets
* Experience working in complex, global, matrixed environments
* Comfort using digital, AI-enabled and modern learning formats
* Strong coordination and stakeholder management skills

**Preferred Qualification**

* Comfortable with LMS platforms, learning data and reporting
* Strong execution and follow-through
* Organised, with attention to detail across many moving parts
* Stakeholder management and clear communication
* Facilitation skills
* Data literacy and a practical improvement mindset
* Comfort working at pace and adapting when plans change

**ELIGIBILITY**
Applicants must meet minimum age qualifications in the country in which the job is located.

* Hands-on manual payroll expertise — you've personally computed salaries, run payroll cycles, and handled month-end reconciliation (not just reviewed someone else's work)

* Strong compliance instinct — you track deadlines proactively, flag risks early, and maintain audit-ready records along with the VP HR.

Our mission is to empower advertisers and brands to unlock the full potential of these platforms' advertising capabilities. By fostering long-lasting partnerships, we create limitless opportunities for people and businesses to advertise effectively at both local and global levels.
  
  
With a presence spanning continents, Aleph offers you the chance to be part of a fast-growing, innovative team where your work makes a direct impact. If you’re ambitious, forward-thinking, and eager to thrive in a dynamic, global environment, Aleph is the perfect place to build your career.
  
  
At Aleph, our people are our greatest asset, and HR is central to our business success. We are looking for a hands-on, strategic
**HR Business Partner (HRBP)**
to lead HR initiatives across our APAC region from our Mumbai office.
  
  
**What You Will Do**
**Serve as a trusted partner to regional leaders**

* Act as the trusted, primary HR advisor and coach for managers and senior leaders in your region on a wide range of topics, including team effectiveness, performance management, and employee relations.
* Translate the regional business agenda into actionable people priorities, aligned with our global HR strategy.
* Provide expert guidance on local labour laws and cultural nuances so that HR practices are compliant and effective across all markets in your scope, in partnership with the Global Labour Law Manager.

**Activate and localise global HR initiatives**

* Lead the rollout and implementation of global programmes in areas such as employee engagement, performance management, and well-being.
* Gather feedback from the region to help improve and iterate on global tools and strategies, ensuring they are fit for purpose.
* Where region-specific needs arise, take the lead on designing and executing local initiatives from start to finish, in partnership with the appropriate Centre of Excellence (CoE) team.

**Champion Culture And Employee Experience**

* Act as a culture enabler, coaching managers on how to embody Aleph’s values (Solutions-Driven, Constantly Evolving, One Team) in their daily leadership.
* Support the entire employee lifecycle, ensuring a positive and consistent experience from onboarding to offboarding.
* Drive a proactive retention strategy for your region using data, stay interviews and exit interviews, and partner with managers on targeted action plans.

**Drive talent and performance excellence**

* Coach managers on navigating performance improvement plans (PIPs) and on holding effective performance and development conversations.
* Partner with Talent Acquisition and People Services Delivery to support workforce planning and key hires within the region.
* Support employer branding initiatives to position Aleph as a top employer in your markets.
* Collaborate with our Centres of Excellence (CoEs) to bring expertise in rewards, talent, and people services to your business stakeholders.
* Collaborate with global and regional Finance on the annual budget process and the quarterly Rolling Forecast.

**Maintain operational excellence**

* Ensure the integrity and accuracy of employee data in the HRIS (meHRaki, powered by Workday) for your region.
* Oversee key HR administrative processes, such as Job Requisitions, Creating Positions and Terminations, ensuring they are efficient, compliant, and deliver a seamless experience for employees and managers.
* Partner with the global HRBP when necessary.

**What We Are Looking For**

* Proven experience: Several years of HR experience in a similar role (for example HR Manager, HR Business Partner or People Partner), preferably with responsibility for multiple countries in a fast-paced, international environment.
* Regional expertise: Strong knowledge of labour and social security laws in key markets (for example, India’s Labour Codes).
* Pragmatic and proactive: A hands-on, execution-focused mindset and the initiative to solve problems. You are comfortable managing both strategic and operational tasks.
* Strong communicator and partner: You build trust quickly and act as an effective sparring partner for managers and leaders. You have excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Coaching mindset: A passion for developing leaders and helping people grow.
* Cultural adaptability: High cross-cultural sensitivity and the ability to adapt your approach to different markets and audiences.
* Collaborative team player: A highly collaborative style and a team-oriented mindset, ready to work closely with a dynamic, cross-cultural HR team.

**Why Join Aleph**

* Impact: Be the primary HR advisor to regional leaders in a business that connects major global platforms with advertisers and consumers across 120+ markets, and turn the regional business agenda into real people priorities.
* Growth: Work alongside global Centres of Excellence in rewards, talent and people services, lead local initiatives from design to delivery, and gain hands-on exposure to the budget and Rolling Forecast process with Finance.
* Team culture: Join a collaborative, cross-cultural HR team built around three values: Solutions-Driven, Constantly Evolving and One Team.

**Why Join Us?**
Aleph is a place of many cultures, perspectives, and talents. We support each other, creating an environment of giving and receiving. We value partnership and communication because we believe it takes a group of people to achieve great things. We are energized by our ever-changing industry, our curiosity keeps us learning and seeking out new opportunities.
  
  
We stay flexible and adaptable, and believe in moving with the speed of change. We encourage everyone to strive for more, providing our internal talent with growth opportunities and the ability to learn together.
  
  
#ALEPH
  
  
We use Lever, our recruitment management platform, which includes AI-powered features that may assist our hiring team in reviewing applications, analyzing CVs, and identifying relevant qualifications. These tools support - but do not replace - human judgement. All hiring decisions are made by people.
