title: Associate Director - HRBP
description:
**About the Company**

Emeritus is committed to teaching the skills of the future by making high-quality education accessible and affordable to individuals, companies, and governments around the world. It does this by collaborating with more than 50 top-tier universities across the United States, Europe, Latin America, Southeast Asia, India and China. Emeritus’ short courses, degree programs, professional certificates, and senior executive programs help individuals learn new skills and transform their lives, companies and organizations. Its unique model of state-of-the-art technology, curriculum innovation, and hands-on instruction from senior faculty, mentors and coaches has educated more than 250,000 individuals across 80+ countries. Founded in 2015, Emeritus, part of Eruditus Group, has more than 2,000 employees globally and offices in Mumbai, New Delhi, Shanghai, Singapore, Palo Alto, Mexico City, New York, Boston, London, and Dubai.

**About the Role**

As the Associate Director - HR Business Partner, you will own the People agenda for assigned business functions, partnering closely with leadership to align people strategy with business priorities and organisational objectives. The role will cover the end-to-end HR agenda, including workforce planning, talent acquisition, onboarding, performance management, employee engagement, employee experience, talent development, retention, employee relations, compensation management and policy compliance. You will act as a trusted advisor to business leaders, providing data-driven insights and practical people solutions to strengthen organisational effectiveness, build leadership capability, enhance employee experience and drive business outcomes. You will also lead the implementation of organisation-wide people initiatives while addressing evolving business and workforce needs.

**Key Responsibilities**

● Own and drive the People strategy for assigned business functions, ensuring alignment with business priorities, growth plans and organisational objectives.

● Own the end-to-end HR agenda, including business partnering, workforce planning, recruitment, onboarding, performance management, employee engagement, talent management, retention, employee relations and policy compliance.

● Partner with business leaders on workforce planning, organisation design, role clarity, team structures, resource allocation and capability requirements to support business objectives.

● Act as a trusted People advisor to senior stakeholders, providing data-led insights and recommendations while driving leadership accountability for people outcomes.

● Partner with Talent Acquisition on hiring plans, critical roles, talent requirements and workforce priorities to ensure the availability of the right talent and capabilities.

● Drive the performance management agenda within the organisation-wide framework, including goal setting, performance conversations, calibration, PIPs, talent reviews and performance-related actions.

● Own employee relations and people matters, including grievances, promotions, internal movements, performance concerns and sensitive employee situations, ensuring fair, consistent and timely decisions.

● Strengthen manager effectiveness through coaching and guidance on performance management, employee development, team effectiveness, difficult conversations and people decisions.

● Drive employee engagement and experience through employee listening, action planning, recognition, career conversations, onboarding, internal mobility, manager transitions and exit experience.

● Identify critical talent, capability gaps, succession requirements and retention risks, partnering with business leaders to develop talent pipelines and strengthen organisational capabilities.

● Use people analytics to monitor key metrics, including attrition, hiring, performance, workforce costs, engagement and talent movement, translating insights into actionable business recommendations.

● Drive change management, organisational effectiveness and process improvements, ensuring effective adoption of organisation-wide people initiatives.

● Ensure adherence to HR policies, processes and systems, identify gaps and collaborate with relevant HR teams to improve HR effectiveness and employee experience.

**Required Skills/Abilities**

● Growth mindset and self-driven approach, with the ability to operate effectively in a complex, fast-paced and evolving environment.

● Strong business acumen and the ability to connect people priorities with business outcomes.

● Excellent stakeholder management, influencing and relationship-building skills, with the ability to partner confidently with senior business leaders.

● Strong communication and interpersonal skills, including the ability to handle sensitive and complex employee situations.

● Strong systems thinking, organisational effectiveness and problem-solving capabilities.

● Highly data-oriented, with strong analytical skills and the ability to translate people insights into actionable interventions.

● Strong planning, organisation and execution skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and drive closure.

● Solution-oriented and hands-on, with the ability to balance strategic thinking with operational execution.

● Ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional stakeholders and HR teams to deliver business-aligned people solutions.

**Other Requirements**

● 8 to 10+ years of experience as a hands-on HR professional, with strong expertise in business partnering, stakeholder management, talent management and employee relations.

● Proven experience partnering with business leaders and owning the People agenda for one or more business functions.

● Demonstrated ability to translate business priorities into people strategies and drive measurable people and organisational outcomes.

● Strong understanding of workforce planning, organisational design, performance management, employee engagement, talent development and retention.

● Demonstrated experience in talent reviews, succession planning, leadership development and manager capability building.

● Experience managing employee relations, performance improvement plans, promotions and other complex people matters.

● Ability to use people analytics and HR technology to inform decisions, identify trends and improve HR effectiveness.

● Experience managing multiple priorities independently in a fast-paced, evolving environment while collaborating cross-functionally.

● Preference for experience in digital consumer, technology, EdTech, new-age/start-up, fast-paced or rapidly scaling organisations.

● Strong awareness of contemporary HR practices and the ability to translate them into practical business interventions.

● Post-graduation in HR from an institute of repute.

title: HR Manager
description:

title: Manager, People Programs & Workforce Transformation, GO-AI
description:
**Description**
The Manager, People Programs & Workforce Transformation will lead the end-to-end talent lifecycle for GO-AI's associate workforce; spanning engagement, performance management, workforce mobility, instructional design, AI upskilling, internal communications, and leadership development. You will own the systems that determine how talent is assessed, certified, moved between programs, and prepared for an AI-augmented future. You will design the certification frameworks that feed automated workforce allocation tools, build the career architecture for roles evolving from manual annotation toward AI quality oversight, and ensure the high-volume hiring pipeline delivers associates who meet readiness standards from day one.
  
  
As GO-AI evolves from a labor-led service to a tech-enabled operation, this role is the engine of workforce transformation, ensuring associates are skilled for emerging AI-augmented work, leaders are developed at every level, and talent mobility systems connect workforce supply to program demand with minimal friction.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Own and evolve the talent programs portfolio across four sub-verticals: Talent Development, Instructional Design, Internal Communications, and Data Insights, ensuring they operate as a unified system serving all Ops pillars
* Own the high-volume hiring pipeline for annotation associates, including assessment design, intake criteria, onboarding velocity targets, and quality-of-hire measurement
* Build and deliver the AI workforce readiness strategy, including upskilling curriculum, digital learning paths, and proficiency certification for associates and leaders operating in AI-augmented workflows
* Define career architecture for evolving roles, establishing progression criteria, skill taxonomies, and readiness assessments at each transition point
* Design and maintain competency certification frameworks that define the skill assessments and certification gates governing cross-pillar workforce movement
* Drive leadership development programs, ensuring structured learning pathways exist at each career transition and measuring leadership effectiveness as a standard metric
* Own retention and engagement levers including employee sentiment platforms, recognition programs, and communications that connect associates across India and Costa Rica to organizational direction
* Lead and develop a geographically distributed team across India and Costa Rica, spanning program managers, instructional designers, communications specialists, and data insights analyst

**About The Team**
GO-AI is a technology enablement organization that accelerates the development and enhances the performance of AI-based robotic and automation solutions for Amazon Robotics (AR) and key Worldwide Operations programs. We combine human expertise with machine learning to produce high-quality training data, validate model outputs, and continuously improve AI system performance across many annotation programs and a large global workforce.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree
* 5+ years of team management experience
* 6+ years of learning & development, talent management, or program management experience
* Experience managing complex curriculum portfolios or learning solution lifecycles for large learner populations (1,000+)
* Experience designing competency or certification frameworks at scale
* Experience managing programs across multiple geographies and cultures

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in AI/ML operations, data annotation, or expert workforce environments
* Experience with workforce mobility, internal talent marketplace, or skills-based talent systems that feed automated workforce allocation decisions
* Experience with high-volume associate hiring pipelines including assessment design and onboarding program ownership
* Experience deploying AI-enabled learning tools (LLM-based training, adaptive learning platforms, AI-powered content generation)
* Experience driving cultural engagement and retention programs

title: HR Manager – Payroll & HR Operations
description:
**About The Opportunity**
Vision Integrated Services Pvt. Ltd. is seeking an experienced and detail-oriented HR Manager to lead end-to-end HR operations, with a primary focus on payroll processing, attendance & leave management, employee relations, recruitment coordination, and HR system implementation—including the Staffingo HRMS platform.
  
  
**Role & Responsibilities**

* Payroll Management: End-to-end monthly payroll processing—collecting and verifying inputs (attendance, leaves, OT, deductions, reimbursements), ensuring statutory compliance, reconciling with Finance, resolving discrepancies, and issuing accurate salary slips on time.
* Attendance & Leave Administration: Daily attendance monitoring, reconciliation of punches/leaves, follow-up on discrepancies, maintaining leave registers, and ensuring data integrity before payroll closure.
* Employee Relations & Support: Serve as first point of contact for employee queries (salary, attendance, leave, policies); conduct daily check-ins, issue communications (welcome, appreciation, warnings), and support engagement initiatives (birthdays, internal updates).
* Recruitment Coordination: Screen candidates, schedule interviews, coordinate BGVs, manage documentation, and support onboarding and induction.
* HR Operations & Documentation: Maintain complete employee files, issue offer/appointment/relieving/experience letters, update HR records, and prepare reports (attendance, payroll, recruitment, compliance).
* Statutory & Admin Support: Administer group mediclaim ( renewals, additions/deletions), process travel bookings and expense validations via TrackMe, and maintain travel records.
* HR Technology Implementation: Lead end-to-end implementation of the Staffingo HRMS—data preparation, testing, stakeholder coordination, issue resolution, and post-go-live support.
* Process Improvement: Identify opportunities to streamline HR workflows, enhance documentation, and improve operational efficiency.

**Must-Have**
**Skills & Qualifications**

* Graduate in any discipline; MBA/PGDM in HR preferred.
* 3–5 years of experience in HR operations, with strong exposure to payroll, attendance, leave management, and employee relations.
* Proven track record in end-to-end monthly payroll processing and statutory compliance (PF, ESIC, etc.).
* Proficiency in MS Excel and HRMS/payroll software.
* Hands-on experience with recruitment coordination, onboarding, BGV, and HR documentation.
* Strong communication, analytical, and problem-solving skills; ability to handle confidential data with integrity.
* Self-driven, organized, and capable of managing multiple priorities independently.

**Preferred**

* MBA/PGDM in Human Resources.

title: Consultant -Enablement, PSS
description:
**Position Summary**
The Consultant, Enablement & Engagement is responsible for driving the adoption and sustained use of new processes, tools, technologies, and ways of working across Platform Services & Support (PSS).
  
  
Working with leaders, site managers, supervisors, champions, subject-matter experts, and change and training teams, this role develops and executes enablement, engagement, communication, and adoption plans aligned with business priorities.
  
  
The Consultant focuses on the people and process aspects of change, ensuring employees understand what is changing, why it matters, and how to apply new capabilities effectively. The role uses extensive knowledge of PSS operations and business processes to address complex adoption challenges, improve existing practices, and develop practical, scalable solutions.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Enablement and Adoption**

* Develop and execute enablement and adoption plans for new processes, tools, platform capabilities, and organizational changes.
* Translate strategic objectives and complex business changes into practical activities that support employee readiness, understanding, and sustained usage.
* Assess change impacts, stakeholder needs, adoption risks, and areas of potential resistance.
* Recommend solutions to address adoption barriers and improve employee and business outcomes.
* Align activities with PSS priorities and established change-management methodologies.

**Stakeholder Engagement**

* Serve as a trusted advisor to PSS leaders, site managers, supervisors, champions, subject-matter experts, and other stakeholders.
* Build alignment, ownership, and commitment across impacted teams and locations.
* Partner with change, training, communications, product, process, and operational teams to coordinate implementation activities.
* Facilitate discussions with business stakeholders and super users to identify communication, training, process, and adoption requirements.

**Implementation and Readiness**

* Lead enablement and engagement activities throughout the implementation lifecycle.
* Develop and maintain stakeholder, communication, training, readiness, and adoption plans.
* Provide input into business requirements, process maps, testing approaches, implementation strategies, and user-experience considerations.
* Assess readiness across impacted PSS locations and identify risks, gaps, dependencies, and corrective actions.
* Ensure changes are launched with clear communications, appropriate training, defined ownership, and effective user support.
* Monitor progress and adjust the enablement approach to support a seamless transition and achievement of business objectives.

**Communications and Training**

* Develop clear, audience-specific communications explaining the purpose, impact, benefits, and expectations associated with a change.
* Collaborate with instructional designers and training leaders to develop learning materials, workshops, job aids, and supporting resources.
* Review training content to ensure business relevance, operational accuracy, and alignment with user needs.
* Lead virtual and in-person training, workshops, engagement sessions, and leadership briefings.
* Ensure users understand new processes, responsibilities, tools, and available support channels.

**Adoption Measurement and Sustainment**

* Define adoption measures, success criteria, feedback mechanisms, and reporting requirements.
* Monitor readiness, employee engagement, usage, process compliance, and adoption during and after implementation.
* Analyze quantitative and qualitative information to identify adoption gaps, delays, or resistance.
* Provide post-implementation reporting, insights, and recommendations to business and enablement leaders.
* Partner with PSS site contacts, product liaison, process, and training teams to address identified issues.
* Conduct periodic follow-ups to confirm that changes are embedded and sustained.
* Recommend targeted actions to increase usage and improve employee, operational, and customer outcomes.

**Process Improvement**

* Evaluate existing enablement, engagement, and business-process practices to identify improvement opportunities.
* Apply process-improvement techniques and relevant industry practices to strengthen implementation outcomes.
* Create reusable standards, tools, templates, and best practices that improve consistency and scalability across PSS.
* Contribute business and process expertise to strategic initiatives, policies, and procedures.

**Scope and Decision-Making**

* Operates with a high level of independence when assessing needs, analyzing adoption challenges, and developing recommendations.
* Applies broad business knowledge and judgment to resolve complex or ambiguous issues.
* Recommends enablement, communication, training, adoption, and sustainment approaches.
* Partners with the Enablement or Change Management Leader for final approval of significant changes to established strategies or methodologies.
* Escalates material risks, barriers, and dependencies that may affect adoption or business outcomes.

**Qualifications And Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in business, organizational change, communications, learning and development, operations, or a related discipline, or equivalent education and experience.
* Minimum of 10 years of relevant functional experience, including at least five years in enablement, change management, business transformation, training, engagement, or process improvement.
* Demonstrated experience developing and implementing enablement, communication, training, or adoption strategies.
* Applied knowledge of change-management and process-improvement methodologies.
* Ability to align strategic objectives with practical execution plans.
* Strong analytical, presentation, facilitation, training, and written communication skills.
* Experience leading virtual and in-person training, workshops, and stakeholder sessions.
* Ability to understand and communicate complex business processes and technology changes.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office and relevant planning, collaboration, reporting, and presentation tools.
* Ability to work across functions, countries, and organizational levels in a fast-paced environment.
* Ability to travel as required.

**Key Competencies**

* Change Leadership
* Collaboration and Influence
* Strategic and Global Mindset
* Results Orientation
* Judgment and Decision-Making
* Stakeholder Engagement
* Business and Process Acumen
* Analytical Thinking
* Communication and Facilitation
* Continuous Improvement
* Adaptability and Resilience

**Measures of Success**

* Increased adoption and sustained usage of new processes, tools, and capabilities.
* Improved readiness and engagement across impacted PSS locations.
* Timely identification and resolution of adoption risks and barriers.
* Effective and consistent communications and training.
* Strong stakeholder alignment, ownership, and accountability.
* Measurable improvements in process compliance, employee experience, and operational performance.
* Scalable enablement practices applied consistently across PSS.

title: HR Generalist
description:
**About Flexport:**
At Flexport, we believe global trade can move the human race forward. That’s why it’s our mission to make global commerce so easy there will be more of it. We’re shaping the future of a $10T industry with solutions powered by innovative technology and exceptional people. Today, companies of all sizes - from emerging brands to Fortune 500s - use Flexport technology to move more than $19B of merchandise across 112 countries a year.

We are proud to have the support of the best investors in the game who believe in our mission, solutions and people. Ready to tackle global challenges that impact business, society, and the environment? Come join us.
  
  
**About The Role**
We’re looking for an experienced HR Generalist, based in Mumbai, to own the full employee lifecycle and people programs across India and the Subcontinent. This is a true generalist role: you’ll run recruiting end to end, manage onboarding through offboarding, and drive the HR operations, compliance, and employee-experience work that keeps our teams thriving. You’ll be the local face of the APAC People team, making sure our ambitious growth is supported by a robust and effective people strategy. We’re building a People function that works smarter with AI, so you’ll be encouraged to use modern AI-powered tools to automate manual work, sharpen sourcing, and free up more time for the human side of HR.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Own full-cycle recruiting for a range of roles across departments - building search strategies, sourcing active and passive candidates, screening, interviewing, and guiding candidates through hiring and onboarding.
* Track sourcing data to focus effort on the channels with the highest ROI, and partner closely with hiring managers to attract, assess, and close top talent.
* Drive proactive recruiting initiatives and help build the Flexport employer brand across the region.
* Communicate candidate pipelines, funnel metrics, and performance data clearly and regularly to internal stakeholders.
* Serve as the local representative of the APAC People team, enhancing employee experience across the full lifecycle from onboarding to offboarding.
* Lead local HR operations including data management, employee support, reporting and analytics, process improvement, payroll support, and policy development.
* Maintain accurate HRIS data in Workday, run audits, and resolve employee tickets.
* Leverage AI-powered tools to automate repetitive HR tasks, source and screen candidates faster, and surface insights from people data.
* Act as the local expert on HR policy and ensure HR compliance across the region.
* Take on additional projects from the global and regional People leadership team as needed.

**What You’ll Bring**

* A BA/BS degree and 6+ years of experience, including full-cycle recruiting at a search firm or fast-growing company.
* A strong track record of processing a wide range of HR transactions and a solid understanding of HR best practices across the APAC region.
* Proven ability to build rapport with hiring managers and cross-functional partners at all levels.
* A creative approach to finding great people, with the ability to build candidate networks and channel connections.
* A drive for results - you see processes through end to end and are motivated by data and metrics.
* Humility: no task is too big or too small.
* Excellent organizational skills and strong attention to detail.
* Hands-on experience with Workday (HCM, recruiting, or reporting) is strongly preferred.
* Comfort adopting AI-powered HR and recruiting tools, with curiosity about how AI can make people processes faster and better.

At Flexport, our ability to fulfill our mission of making global commerce easy and accessible relies on having a diverse, dedicated and engaged workforce. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment regardless of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, physical and mental disability, health status, marital and family status, sexual orientation, gender identity and expression, military and veteran status, and any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

description:
**About Media.net**

Media.net is a leading online ad-tech company that develops innovative products for advertisers and publishers. Media.net has one of the most comprehensive portfolios of advertising technology in the industry across search, native, display, mobile, local, products and video. Media.net manages high-quality ad supply on over 500,000 websites and its platform and products are licensed by some of the largest publishers, ad networks and other ad tech companies worldwide.

Media.net is one of the largest contextual advertising company worldwide. Media.net has key operation centers across – North America, Europe and Asia. Media.net's US HQ is based in New York, and Global HQ in Dubai.

**Role Snapshot:**

* **Location:**
  Mumbai (Andheri East), India; on-site or hybrid.
* **Shift:**
  US overlap, roughly 6 PM–3 AM IST, with flexibility for US payroll and onboarding peaks.
* **Experience:**
  4–7 years in Global HR Operations, with at least 2 years supporting US employees.
* **Works With:**
  US employees and managers, third-party payroll/PEO vendor, US benefits and 401(k) providers, India HR and Finance.

**About the role:**

This person is the single operational point of contact for our US employees, run from India. They own the US employee lifecycle end to end — onboarding, benefits and 401(k) changes, offboarding — and keep the third-party payroll vendor and our employees in sync.

The role executes and coordinates; it does not set US policy or give legal or tax advice. Compliance judgment sits with the payroll vendor and US counsel, and this person knows when to escalate to them.

This role will closely work with the CxOs and other POCs from the New York Office on day to day basis

**Key responsibilities:**

**US onboarding**

* Run new-hire onboarding for US employees: offer-to-day-one checklist, document collection, and system setup with the payroll vendor.
* Coordinate Form I-9 completion and E-Verify (where used) within federal timelines, plus W-4 and state tax forms.
* Enrol new hires in benefits and 401(k) within plan eligibility windows; run a first-week orientation on pay, benefits and policies.

**401(k) and benefits administration**

* Process 401(k) enrolments, contribution changes, and employer-match updates with the plan provider and payroll vendor.
* Reconcile payroll deductions against 401(k) remittances each pay cycle and flag mismatches before they become late deposits.
* Support open enrolment, qualifying life events, and annual plan communications.

**Offboarding**

* Run exits end to end: final pay on time per state rules, PTO payout, asset and access recovery, and exit interviews.
* Coordinate COBRA notices, 401(k) separation options, and benefit terminations with the vendor.

**HR policy**

* Maintain the US employee handbook and policies, keeping them aligned with federal and applicable state requirements.
* Track US law and benefit changes flagged by the vendor or counsel, and drive the resulting policy updates.
* Field policy questions and apply policy consistently.

**Payroll vendor liaison**

* Act as the primary contact for the third-party payroll/PEO vendor: submit inputs (new hires, changes, exits, bonuses) ahead of each cutoff.
* Review payroll registers before approval and resolve errors with the vendor.
* Track vendor SLAs and escalate recurring issues.

**Employee queries and coordination**

* Resolve US employee queries on pay, tax forms, benefits, 401(k) and leave, with a ticket or log for every query.
* Translate vendor responses into clear answers for employees, and employee issues into clear asks for the vendor.
* Keep employee records and HRIS data accurate and audit-ready.

**Must-have qualifications:**

* Graduate; MBA/PGDM in HR preferred.
* 4–7 years in HR operations, including at least 2 years directly supporting US employees (in-house, GCC, or a US-payroll/PEO outsourcing firm).
* Hands-on knowledge of US onboarding and exit mechanics: I-9, W-4, state new-hire reporting, final-pay rules, COBRA.
* Working knowledge of 401(k) administration: enrolment, deferral changes, employer match, and payroll-to-provider reconciliation.
* Experience managing a payroll or PEO vendor (e.g. ADP, Gusto, Rippling, Justworks, TriNet, Paychex) and reviewing payroll registers.
* Strong written English for employee-facing communication; comfortable on calls with US staff.
* Willing to work a sustained US-overlap shift.
* High discretion with confidential pay and personal data.

**Good-to-have:**

* SHRM-CP or HRCI (PHR/aPHR) certification.
* Exposure to multi-state US employment (e.g. California, New York) and state-specific leave rules.
* Experience with an HRIS such as Workday, BambooHR or Darwinbox, plus a ticketing tool for query tracking.
* Has written or updated an employee handbook.
* Advanced Excel for payroll and 401(k) reconciliations.

**Success in the First 6 Months:**

* **Payroll Timeliness:**
  Submit 100% of payroll inputs before the vendor cutoff for every pay cycle.
* **Payroll Accuracy:**
  Maintain zero repeat errors attributable to our inputs.
* **401(k) Reconciliation:**
  Reconcile deductions against remittances during every pay cycle, with all mismatches resolved within the same cycle.
* **I-9 Compliance:**
  Complete I-9 documentation for 100% of new hires within the federally mandated deadlines.
* **Final Pay Compliance:**
  Ensure 100% of employee exits receive final pay in accordance with applicable state laws.
* **Employee Query Management:**
  Acknowledge employee queries within 1 business day and resolve them within 5 business days.
* **US Employee Handbook:**
  Review and update the US employee handbook by the end of Month 6.

description:
**Company Description**
IceWarp is a global collaboration and communication platform that offers an integrated alternative to MS 365 and Google Workspace. The company enables streamlined business processes through real-time collaboration tools, easy file sharing, and a unified virtual office experience from a single window, without third-party applications. IceWarp serves over 50 million paid users and 50,000 customers across more than 50 countries, emphasizing security, efficiency, and ease of use. Founded in 2001, IceWarp is fully developed in-house, with ongoing innovation and product updates to meet evolving workplace needs.

**Role Description**
The Manager – Talent Management & Development is a full-time, on-site role based in Mumbai. This role is responsible for designing and implementing talent management strategies, including performance management frameworks, succession planning initiatives, and career development programs.

The role will own the employee learning journey from induction and onboarding through structured
**30, 60 and 90-day enablement plans**
, followed by ongoing development. The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience implementing an LMS, conducting assessments, managing training partners and working with business leaders to deliver measurable improvements in employee performance.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**New Joiner Onboarding & Enablement**

•⁠ ⁠Design and execute structured induction, onboarding and on-the-job training programmes across functions.

•⁠ ⁠Develop role-specific
**30, 60 and 90-day plans**
with clear learning objectives, milestones, assessments and readiness criteria.

•⁠ ⁠Coordinate with reporting managers, subject matter experts and HR to ensure timely execution.

•⁠ ⁠Track new joiner progress, identify learning gaps and implement corrective interventions.

•⁠ ⁠Provide documented readiness recommendations to support probation and confirmation decisions.

**Training Needs Analysis & Learning Programmes:**

•⁠ ⁠Identify individual, team and organisational training needs through stakeholder discussions, performance data and competency assessments.

•⁠ ⁠Develop and execute a training calendar aligned with business priorities.

•⁠ ⁠Organise regular functional, behavioural and managerial workshops.

•⁠ ⁠Deliver or coordinate programmes covering communication, interpersonal skills, emotional intelligence (EQ), analytical thinking, problem-solving and cognitive abilities (IQ).

•⁠ ⁠Build structured learning paths for different roles and levels.

**Assessments & Learning Effectiveness:**

•⁠ ⁠Develop pre- and post-training assessments, practical evaluations and competency-based reviews.

•⁠ ⁠Coordinate appropriate behavioural, emotional intelligence and cognitive assessments, using qualified providers where required.

•⁠ ⁠Track knowledge retention, application on the job and progress against agreed capability standards.

•⁠ ⁠Evaluate training effectiveness through assessment outcomes, manager feedback and changes in employee performance.

•⁠ ⁠Maintain assessment records and ensure timely communication of results and development actions.

**LMS Implementation & Administration:**

•⁠ ⁠Lead or actively manage LMS implementation, including requirements gathering, vendor evaluation, configuration, testing and rollout.

•⁠ ⁠Create learning paths, upload content, configure assessments and manage training assignments.

•⁠ ⁠Drive LMS adoption among employees and managers.

•⁠ ⁠Monitor course completion, assessment results and learning engagement through LMS reports.

•⁠ ⁠Coordinate with IT and vendors to resolve issues and improve platform usability.

**Stakeholder & Training Vendor Management:**

•⁠ ⁠Partner with business heads, reporting managers and HR to agree on learning priorities and expected outcomes.

•⁠ ⁠Establish clear ownership for training delivery, employee participation and progress reviews.

•⁠ ⁠Evaluate and manage external trainers, training institutes, assessment partners and content providers.

•⁠ ⁠Manage training proposals, commercials, schedules, delivery quality and vendor performance.

•⁠ ⁠Monitor training budgets and evaluate the value delivered by learning programmes.

**Employee Performance & Development:**

•⁠ ⁠Track employee development against agreed learning goals, competency requirements and performance milestones.

•⁠ ⁠Support managers in translating performance gaps into practical development plans.

•⁠ ⁠Facilitate regular development reviews and monitor completion of agreed actions.

•⁠ ⁠Identify high-potential employees and support career development and succession planning.

•⁠ ⁠Work with HR and business leaders to strengthen feedback, coaching and continuous learning practices.

**Performance Improvement Plans:**

•⁠ ⁠Partner with HR and reporting managers to develop and monitor structured
**Performance Improvement Plans (PIPs).**

•⁠ ⁠Define measurable improvement goals, review timelines, learning support and accountability.

•⁠ ⁠Coordinate relevant training, coaching and assessments during the PIP period.

•⁠ ⁠Document progress, review discussions and outcomes to support consistent, evidence-based decisions.

**Reporting & Governance:**

•⁠ ⁠Maintain dashboards covering onboarding milestones, training participation, LMS completion, assessment results and employee development progress.

•⁠ ⁠Track time to proficiency, overdue learning actions and PIP progress.

•⁠ ⁠Present regular updates to leadership, highlighting capability gaps, outcomes and recommended actions.

•⁠ ⁠Maintain accurate training records, assessment documentation and development plans.

**Required Experience & Qualifications**

•⁠ ⁠
**Minimum 10 years of relevant experience in Talent Management, Learning & Development or Employee Enablement within the IT industry.**

•⁠ ⁠Proven experience working as a Manager in the same domain, with ownership of learning programmes and employee development initiatives.

•⁠ ⁠Demonstrated experience designing and executing structured onboarding and 30–60–90-day enablement plans.

•⁠ ⁠Hands-on involvement in at least one LMS implementation, along with experience managing LMS administration, reporting and adoption.

•⁠ ⁠Experience conducting training needs analysis, competency assessments and learning effectiveness reviews.

•⁠ ⁠Experience facilitating workshops and managing external training vendors.

•⁠ ⁠Exposure to behavioural, EQ and cognitive assessments and their appropriate use in employee development.

•⁠ ⁠Experience supporting performance management, development planning and PIPs.

•⁠ ⁠Graduate or postgraduate qualification in HR, Psychology, Business Management or a related discipline.

**Key Competencies:**

•⁠ ⁠Stakeholder management and business partnering

•⁠ ⁠Training facilitation and coaching

•⁠ ⁠Programme planning and execution

•⁠ ⁠Interpersonal skills and emotional intelligence

•⁠ ⁠Vendor and budget management

•⁠ ⁠Data analysis and performance reporting

•⁠ ⁠Ownership, follow-through and attention to detail

**Success Measures:**

•⁠ ⁠Timely completion of onboarding and 30–60–90-day milestones.

•⁠ ⁠Improved new joiner readiness and reduced time to proficiency.

•⁠ ⁠Strong LMS adoption and timely completion of assigned learning.

•⁠ ⁠Measurable improvement in assessment results and on-the-job capability.

•⁠ ⁠Consistent execution of training calendars and development plans.

•⁠ ⁠Timely PIP reviews and documented progress against improvement goals.

\*Interested candidates with relevant IT industry experience are invited to apply with their updated CV.\*

**Job Description**
At Johnson & Johnson, we believe health is everything. Our strength comes from the people who bring our purpose to life every day. We are committed to creating a workplace where employees feel respected, supported, and empowered to do their best work.
  
  
We are seeking an
**Employee & Labor Relations Leader, India**
to help us build a positive, inclusive, and high-performing work environment across India. In this leadership role, we will rely on your expertise to guide employee and labour relations strategy, support business transformation, and foster strong relationships across our workforce.
  
  
Working closely with business leaders, HR partners, managers, employees, and employee representatives, we will partner to address sophisticated workplace matters, strengthen organizational capability, and ensure our people practices reflect both our values and business priorities.
  
  
This is an exciting opportunity to influence people strategy at a national level, lead a team, and make a lasting impact on employee experience, organizational effectiveness, and business success.
  
  
**What You'll Do**
As Head of ERLR, India, you will help shape and deliver our Employee Relations (ER) and Labour Relations (LR) strategy while supporting a culture of trust, accountability, fairness, and inclusion.
  
  
You will partner with leaders and HR teams to proactively find opportunities and challenges across the employee lifecycle, providing guidance that supports both employees and strategic objectives.
  
  
**Key Areas Of Responsibility Include**
**Employee Relations**

* Guide the resolution of sophisticated employee relations matters, including grievances, investigations, disciplinary issues, and workplace concerns.
* Partner with leaders and HR teams to ensure consistent, fair, and respectful approaches to employee relations matters.
* Build confidence and capability among managers through coaching, training, and practical guidance.
* Help creates a positive employee experience by fostering open communication, trust, and constructive workplace relationships.

**Labour Relations**

* Lead labour relations strategy and provide oversight for unionized employee populations across India.
* Support the preparation, negotiation, and implementation of Collective Bargaining Agreements (CBAs).
* Foster constructive relationships with union representatives and employee groups.
* Provide guidance on labour relations implications related to business transformation activities, including restructuring, acquisitions, divestitures, outsourcing, and workforce changes.

**Strategy, Governance & Compliance**

* Partner with stakeholders to create and implement an Employee & Labour Relations strategy aligned with regional and global priorities.
* Assess employment and labour legislation trends, helping the organization adapt to a changing regulatory environment.
* Support governance activities and ensure workplace practices align with legal requirements, company values, and employee expectations.
* Use insights and data to identify trends, address risks, and improve workplace outcomes.

**Continuous Improvement & Innovation**

* Find opportunities to improve processes, policies, and service delivery models.
* Champion innovative ways of working that improve employee experience and operational effectiveness.
* Support organizational change initiatives that help our workforce and business succeed in a vibrant environment.

**What We're Looking For**
We welcome candidates who bring a combination of employee relations expertise, business partnership, leadership capability, and a passion for creating positive workplace experiences.
  
  
**Qualifications & Experience**

* Post Graduate degree required; Human Resources, Industrial Relations, Employment Law, Legal Studies, or related fields preferred.
* Significant experience in Human Resources, Employee Relations, Labour Relations, Industrial Relations, or Employment Law.
* Experience leading and developing teams in complex, matrixed organizations.
* Solid knowledge of employee relations practices, labour relations frameworks, and employment legislation.
* Experience managing complex workplace matters, organizational change initiatives, and workforce transformation activities.
* Strong stakeholder management, influencing, communication, and relationship-building skills.
* Ability to balance employee needs, business priorities, and legal considerations while driving fair and sustainable outcomes.
* Proven track record to navigate ambiguity, tackle sophisticated problems, and make sound decisions.

**AI & Future Ways of Working**
We recognize the growing role of technology in the workplace and value leaders who are curious, adaptable, and open to new ways of working. Experience leveraging AI-enabled tools, understanding responsible AI practices, and using effective prompting techniques to improve productivity, decision-making, and collaboration will be an advantage.
  
  
**Key Capabilities**
We are particularly interested in leaders who:
  
  

* Build trusted relationships across all levels of an organization.
* Connect with empathy, clarity, and confidence.
* Foster inclusive, respectful, and collaborative workplaces.
* Use data and insights to support decision-making.
* Embrace innovation and continuous improvement.

At Talent team, we empower you to have a sense of purpose and opportunities that add value to your overall career experience at EY. The team works together across functions and service lines to build strategic solutions that support our strategy and employer value proposition (EVP).
  
  
The team partners effectively with the business leaders, providing strategic talent advice to work in an integrated manner, leveraging solutions and best practices. The teams are responsible for enabling the business, driving the engagement of our people locally and bringing our strategy and EVP to life.
  
  
The team includes workstreams like, Business Partnering, Talent Acquisition, Learning and Development, Mobility, Compensation and benefit and enabling functions like HR systems, Operations, People Data Reporting and Analytics. They also leverage our global strength and scalability to drive HR-related technology, projects and processes that allow EY to deliver against the changing requirements to enable success. The core focus of the team is to ensure an exceptional EY experience lasts a lifetime.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**
**Technical Excellence**

* Head – Talent Innovation & Transformation Center (TITC) (AI-First People Transformation | Big 4 Context) Role Summary: The Head of TITC owns the re-engineering of EY India’s Talent processes using technology and AI—ensuring measurable impact, strong governance, and seamless adoption across the firm. Function: Talent Management Location: New Delhi, Bangalore, Mumbai Reporting to: CHRO – EY India Role Purpose (Why this role exists) The Head – Talent Innovation & Transformation Center (TITC) is the enterprise owner of AI-led Talent transformation for EY India. The role exists to re-engineer HR processes end-to-end using technology, artificial intelligence, data, and automation, while preserving EY’s partnership culture, risk discipline, and service-line ownership. This is not an HR operations role and not a pure AI or technology role. It is a senior Talent transformation leadership position that sits at the intersection of Talent Management, consulting-style problem solving, technology and data, risk and governance, and enterprise-scale change. Positioning in the EY System Reports to: CHRO - India People Leader Works closely with:
* CHRO and Senior People Leadership Team
* Service Line Leaders and SL Talent Partners (Consulting, Audit, Tax, EY-Parthenon, SaT, CBS)
* HR Functional Heads (Talent Acquisition, Learning & Development, HR Business Partners, Rewards, Infrastructure, Strategy)
* Risk, Legal, IT, Finance, Data & Technology leadership Acts as:
* Single point of accountability for Talent transformation
* Internal Transformation Partner to HR and the business Core Mandate (What success looks like)
* Create and sustain a clear Talent Technology and AI transformation vision and roadmap for EY India.
* Re-engineer high-impact Talent Management and HR processes.
* Embed Automation and GEN AI into HR workflows rather than deploying parallel or disconnected tools.
* Drive sustained adoption and measurable value realization.
* Ensure governance, ethics, and risk discipline consistent with industry and in a Big 4 firm. Key Responsibilities (Detailed) 1. Enterprise People AI Strategy & Roadmap
* Define the People AI North Star for EY India aligned to firm strategy.
* Build and maintain a three-year transformation roadmap across the people lifecycle.
* Prioritize AI use-cases based on business impact, risk profile, data readiness, and change complexity.
* Ensure clarity of strategy and avoid experimentation without enterprise value. 2. People Process Re-Engineering Ownership
* Identify high-friction, high-cost Talent Management and HR processes.
* Lead end-to-end process redesign before AI is applied.
* Eliminate duplication, manual effort, and unnecessary approvals.
* Define scalable future-state workflows respecting regulatory and service-line constraints. 3. Technology AI Enablement & Architecture Oversight (Not Coding)
* Partner with HR Technology and IT to define the People AI stack.
* Make informed buy, build, or partner decisions.
* Ensure AI is embedded into Workday, LMS, ATS, and core HR tools.
* Maintain role-based access, explainability, and auditability. 4. Value Realization & Adoption
* Shift focus from pilots to everyday AI usage in decisions.
* Define success KPI metrics such as efficiency, effectiveness, productivity improvement and/or cycle-time reduction.
* Hold HR functions accountable for outcomes and continuous improvement. 5. Governance, Risk & Ethics Leadership
* Co-own People AI governance with Risk, Legal, and Technology teams.
* Define human-in-the-loop standards and bias mitigation mechanisms.
* Determine where AI use is allowed, constrained, or prohibited. 6. Cultural Fit – EY Big 4 DNA
* Comfort operating in ambiguity and influence-based authority.
* Ability to balance bold thinking with stakeholder diplomacy and risk consciousness.
* Strong executive presence, team leadership and credibility with senior partners.
* Respect for partnership culture, independence, and regulatory boundaries.
* Ability to build coalitions rather than command control.
* Manage resistance from senior HR leaders, HRBPs, and partners. Critical Challenges the Role Will Manage
* Balancing innovation velocity with Big 4 risk and independence requirements.
* Driving enterprise change without disrupting BAU HR delivery.
* Managing service-line diversity and autonomy at scale.
* Overcoming skepticism from senior HR leaders and partners.
* Ensuring AI adoption rather than tool fatigue.
* Translating complex AI concepts into clear business language.

**Skills And Attributes**
**To qualify for the role you must have**
**Qualification**

* B.E with MBA / PGDM from a top-tier or strong Tier-1 / Tier-2 institution. Certifications in transformation, analytics, or AI are valued but not mandatory.

**Experience**

* 18–25+ years of experience with demonstrated leadership of large-scale HR or enterprise transformations in matrixed, partnership-driven organizations.

**What We Look For**
People with the ability to work in a collaborative manner to provide services across multiple client departments while following the commercial and legal requirements. You will need a practical approach to solving issues and complex problems with the ability to deliver insightful and practical solutions. We look for people who are agile, curious, mindful, and able to sustain positive energy, while being adaptable and creative in their approach.
  
  
**What We Offer**
Fuelled by the brilliance of our people, EY has emerged as the strongest brand and the most attractive employer in our field, with market-leading growth over competitors. Our people work side-by-side with market-leading entrepreneurs, game-changers, disruptors, and visionaries. As an organization, we are investing more time, technology, and money than ever before in skills and learning for our people. At EY, you will have a personalized Career Journey and also the chance to tap into the resources of our career frameworks to better know about your roles, skills, and opportunities.
  
  
EY is equally committed to being an inclusive employer, and we strive to achieve the right balance for our people—enabling us to deliver excellent client service while allowing our people to build their careers as well as focus on their wellbeing.
  
  
If you can confidently demonstrate that you meet the criteria above, please contact us as soon as possible.
  
  
Join us in shaping the future with confidence. Apply Now

title: HR Manager
description:

Location: Mumbai

* Proficiency in flight and hotel bookings and travel coordination.
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
* Excellent communication, follow-up, and coordination skills.
* Ability to handle multiple responsibilities independently and maintain confidentiality.

title: HR AI Projects
description:
**Role:**
HR AI Projects

**Role Description:**

We are looking for a highly motivated fresh graduate to support AI-led HR transformation initiatives.

The role will involve understanding HR processes, identifying opportunities for automation and intelligent intervention, and determining whether a use case is best addressed through AI Agents, Generative AI, Chatbots, RPA, Machine Learning or traditional technology solutions.

Candidates should be able to understand the business/process problem first and then identify the most appropriate technology solution.

**What we are looking for:**

**Candidate Requirements:**

**Qualification:**

* Candidates pursuing or recently completing a degree in Computer Science, AI, ML, Data Science, IT, Software Engineering, Electronics or related disciplines.
* Candidate with with strong hands-on AI/automation projects

**Experience:**
Freshers, Recent Graduates, or Final-Year Students.

**Technical Skills:**

* Hands-on exposure to AI/ML and Generative AI.
* Experience building AI Agents, Chatbots or Bots
* Python or another programming language  Understanding of LLMs, APIs and system integrations
* Basic Machine Learning knowledge.
* Exposure to RPA/automation tools such as UiPath, Power Automate or Automation Anywhere
* Understanding of prompt engineering and LLM workflows.
* SQL/database knowledge is an advantage.
* Experience building AI Agents / Agentic AI workflows.
* Exposure to frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen or similar frameworks.
* Experience integrating LLMs with APIs/tools.
* Academic or personal projects involving AI, automation or ML.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Understand HR processes across areas such as HR Operations, Recruitment, Employee Experience, Payroll, Learning, Benefits and Attendance.
* Analyse process flows, dependencies, data, decision points and manual interventions.
* Identify opportunities to simplify, digitise, automate or intelligently automate HR processes.
* Evaluate the appropriate technology approach — RPA, AI Agents, GenAI, Chatbots, ML, APIs or traditional workflows.
* Develop AI agents, bots and automation solutions, including Proofs of Concept (PoCs).
* Work with LLMs, APIs, automation platforms and AI/ML technologies.
* Support data analysis, model development and validation of AI outputs where required. Challenge existing processes and design improved future-state processes.
* Test solutions, identify edge cases and support pilot implementation.
* Document use cases, solution approaches, learnings and recommendations.

title: Recruitment Specialist cum HR
description:
**Employment Type:**
Full-Time or Part-Time

**Department:**
Human Resources / Talent Acquisition

**Reporting To:**
General Manager

**Position Overview**

**We are looking for a dedicated, experienced and highly proactive Recruitment Specialist**
to manage the company's internal recruitment based in UAE.

This position may be offered on a
**full-time or part-time basis**
, depending on the candidate's experience, availability and suitability for the role.

The primary responsibility is to
**identify, attract, assess and recruit high-quality talent primarily for our company's business, sales, customer service and operations functions**
.

The successful candidate should be a hands-on recruiter with strong sourcing and headhunting capabilities, excellent knowledge of the UAE talent market and the ability to work independently with minimum supervision.

This is an
**in-house recruitment position**
, not an agency recruitment role. The Recruitment Specialist will work directly with our management team to understand manpower requirements and recruit the right people for our organisation.

**Core Recruitment Areas**

**The primary recruitment requirements will include:**

**Business & Sales**

**Customer Service**

**Operations & Business Support**

**Key Responsibilities**

* Understand manpower requirements directly from management and department heads.
* Develop clear recruitment specifications for each position.
* Proactively source candidates through LinkedIn, job portals, professional networks, referrals and databases and any other sources.
* Conduct direct sourcing and headhunting for key positions.
* Screen CVs and conduct initial interviews.
* Assess candidates for experience, competence, communication, attitude and cultural fit.
* Shortlist and present suitable candidates to management.
* Organize and co-ordinate interviews and obtain timely feedback.
* Manage the offer and joining process in coordination with HR.
* Maintain an updated recruitment pipeline and talent database.
* Build talent pools for frequently required positions.
* Maintain regular recruitment reports for management.
* Ensure vacancies are followed through to successful closure.
* Maintain confidentiality and professional standards throughout the recruitment process.

**Performance Expectations**

**The Recruitment Specialist will be expected to demonstrate:**

* Strong and consistent candidate sourcing activity
* Quality candidates rather than simply high volumes of CVs
* Fast response to internal recruitment requirements
* Strong interview-to-selection conversion
* High offer-acceptance and joining ratios
* Ability to fill vacancies within agreed timelines
* Development of a strong internal talent pipeline
* Excellent follow-up with candidates and management
* High-quality recruitment and employee retention
* Strong ownership and accountability

**Ideal Candidate**

**The ideal candidate is not simply an HR administrator or CV screener**
.

We are looking for a professional who can independently
**find the right people, approach them, assess them and bring them successfully into the organisation**
.

The candidate should be:

**Experienced • Proactive • Well Connected • Target-Oriented • Persistent • Commercially Aware • Excellent in Communication • Strong in Follow-Up**

**Candidates with strong UAE recruitment experience and an established professional network in Dubai will be preferred.**

**Experience**

* Minimum 5 to 8
  **years of hands-on recruitment experience**
  , in Dubai/UAE.
* Proven experience recruiting business, sales, customer service and operations professionals.
* Strong LinkedIn sourcing and headhunting experience.
* Excellent English communication skills.

**Compensation**

**Part-Time:**
Compensation to be mutually agreed based on experience, working arrangement and expected deliverables.

Performance-based incentives may be considered for exceptional recruitment results.

**Application**

**Candidates should submit their CV along with:**

* Positions previously recruited
* Typical number of successful hires per month
* Current/last salary
* Expected salary for full time or part-time remuneration
* Availability & Full-time or part-time preference

title: HR Systems Support Specialist, MEA/EAP
description:
Doka is a global leader in innovative formwork solutions and services across all areas of construction, and a worldwide supplier of comprehensive scaffolding systems for a broad range of applications. With more than 160 sales and logistics facilities in over 54 countries, Doka provides a high‑performing distribution network that ensures expert advice, customer service and technical support on site, with equipment delivered quickly regardless of project size or complexity. Employing 8,000 people worldwide, Doka is part of the Umdasch Group, a company that has stood for reliability, experience and trustworthiness for more than 150 years and serves as the parent organization for its directly affiliated divisions, including Doka, Umdasch The Store Makers and Umdasch Industrial Solutions.

Established to provide a versatile network of products, systems and expertise, the areas Doka Middle East & Africa and Doka Asia Pacific (APAC) support some of the world’s fastest growing economies. This positions Doka as a strong partner for a wide range of projects, from major infrastructure such as metro systems, bridges and tunnels to cost efficient housing developments. Headquartered in Dubai, United Arab Emirates, and Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia, the Doka MEA and APAC Area teams serve as the central hubs for key functions across the regions and act as links to our headquarters in Austria.

Do you enjoy solving system challenges, helping people get the best out of technology, and improving the way HR works? Are you someone who combines technical curiosity with a passion for delivering an excellent user experience?

We are looking for an
**HR Systems Support Specialist**
to join our MEA & East Asia Pacific HR team. This newly created role offers the opportunity to work with multiple countries, supporting the rollout, project management, optimisation and day-to-day success of our HR systems while collaborating with colleagues across the region and at our global headquarters.

Working closely with the Area Compensation & Benefits Specialist and our global HR Systems team, you will play an important role in ensuring our HR platforms and projects are reliable, user-friendly and aligned with global standards. Your work will directly support our digitalisation journey and help create a seamless experience for HR teams and employees across the region.

If you enjoy combining technology, problem-solving and collaboration in an international environment—and can confidently train and communicate with stakeholders at all levels, from HR users and country teams to regional and global colleagues—we'd love to hear from you.

This position will be based in India and report to the Head of HR MEA/EAP based in Dubai and work closely with the Compensation & Benefits Specialist MEA/EAP.

**Job Description**

**WHAT IF your HR systems expertise enhanced the employee experience across MEA & EAP?**

**What you'll be doing**

As our regional HR Systems Support Specialist, you will:

* Provide first-line support and user training for HR systems across the Middle East, Africa and East Asia Pacific, including
  **SAP HCM, SuccessFactors, SmartRecruiters, Aemlic (former Centric, electronic personnel file)**
  and
  **SAP**
  **Concur (expense management)**
  .
* Support the planning, coordination and successful implementation of HR system rollouts across multiple countries.
* Help maintain high-quality employee data by ensuring compliance with global standards while supporting local business requirements.
* Drive continuous improvement by listening to user feedback, identifying opportunities to enhance processes and recommending practical solutions within our global framework and considering AI tools and potential / future readiness.
* Maintain and update organisational structures and master data within our HR systems.
* Prepare and deliver standard reports to support HR operations and decision-making.
* Partner closely with the Area Compensation & Benefits Specialist, Global HR Process & Systems team, AI Lead and HR colleagues across the region.
* Analyse system incidents and enhancement requests, providing first-level support and coordinating with the Global HR Systems team for advanced issues.

**Qualifications**

**What we're looking for**

You are someone who enjoys learning new systems, solving problems and working with people from different cultures and backgrounds. You communicate clearly and confidently with stakeholders at all levels, building trust through your approachable style and ability to translate technical topics into practical solutions. You have a structured way of working, pay close attention to detail and take pride in delivering high-quality support.

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology or another relevant field.
* At least
  **5 years' experience**
  in a similar HR systems support role within an international corporate environment.
* Proven experience supporting HR system implementations, including planning, user training and rollout activities.
* Strong working knowledge of
  **SAP HCM**
  or
  **SuccessFactors (Performance, Goals, Succession, Talent Management, Learning)**
  ; experience with
  **SmartRecruiters**
  and
  **Power BI**
  would be an advantage.
* Experience providing end-user support and troubleshooting system-related issues.
* Receptive mindset and enthusiastic curiosity towards innovative AI tools and technologies
* A customer-focused, solution-oriented mindset with excellent interpersonal and communication skills, enabling you to build effective relationships and confidently support stakeholders at all organisational levels while balancing local business needs with global standards.
* Strong organisational skills, attention to detail and analytical thinking.
* A collaborative team player who enjoys working in an international, high-performing environment.

**Additional Information**

**Why join us?**

This is an opportunity to become part of a global organisation where technology and people come together to improve the employee experience. You'll gain exposure to regional and global HR initiatives, work with modern HR technologies and collaborate with experienced colleagues across multiple countries. If you're looking for a role where you can make a tangible impact while continuing to develop your expertise in HR systems, we'd be excited to welcome you to our team.

title: HR Benefits Analyst
description:
The HR Benefits Analyst is an entry-level position responsible for providing operations support services, including but not limited to; record/documentation maintenance, storage & retrieval of records, account maintenance, imaging and the opening of accounts in coordination with the Operations - Core Team. Additionally, the Ops Sup Analyst 1 serves as the liaison between operations staff, relationship managers, project managers, custodians and clients. The overall objective of this role is to provide day-to-day operations support in alignment with Citi operations support infrastructure and processes.
  
  
**Responsibilities:**

* Perform business analysis and documentation of the current and future state of Client Reports and Advices (client communication letters, notices, and confirms)
* Provide regular status updates for all project participants and create presentations for steering committee updates
* Work with various Legal & Compliance teams to obtain sign-off on all regulatory business requirements
* Serve as primary liaison between the key business stakeholder and technology, including recommending business priorities by advising stakeholders on options, risks, costs, prioritizations, and delivery timelines
* Recommend business priorities by advising stakeholders on options, risks, costs, prioritizations, and delivery timelines
* Create and facilitate training sessions, webcast demos and write User Acceptance Test scripts and business scenarios against specified requirements
* Create, manage and maintain project plans and act as the project manager for all follow ups across various departments

description:

The HR Manager position is a hands-on working position, reporting to the Sr. Director Business Partner. The role is expected to act as a trusted consultant and partner (coach, advise, counsel) to the assigned business organization(s). SAFETY, SECURITY & COMPLIANCE

* Places Quality, Health & Safety, Security and protection of the Environment as core values while never intentionally placing employees, our processes, customers or the communities in which we live and work at risk.
* Seeks continual improvement in Health, Safety, Security & protection of the Environment, taking into account responsible care, process vulnerabilities, public, customer and employee inputs, knowledge and technology and best business practices to exceed customer expectations.
* Supervisors & Managers should demonstrate effective safety leadership for the health and safety arrangements of all subordinates and for any persons visiting them while on the Company premises.

OPERATIONS
  
  

* Anticipates, identifies and analyzes business opportunities, needs and challenges to deliver solutions which address them.
* Contributes to the Weatherford HR strategy and translates it for the client and India All Business.

* Contributes from design through execution on organization, portfolio and leadership changes and the change management of each.

QUALITY
  
  

* Responsible for being familiar with the Company's Quality policies and takes an active role in the compliance and improvement of Weatherfords Management System.
* Maintains service quality as immediate priorities when working across all areas of the business and continually seeks areas for improvement.

COMMUNICATION
  
  

* Effectively communicates with a global, cross-functional and diverse workforce focused on continuous HR service delivery quality and productivity improvement.

* Maintains effective communications with all key stakeholders both internal and where appropriate external.
* Supervisors & Managers should clearly communicate expectations, roles and responsibilities to their reports.

FINANCIAL

PEOPLE & DEVELOPMENT

VISION & LEADERSHIP

* Demonstrate leadership, ethical behaviour and adherence to Weatherford standards at all times

title: Total Rewards Operations Leader/Benefits Manager
description:
At Dow, we believe in putting people first and we’re passionate about delivering integrity, respect and safety to our customers, our employees and the planet.
  
  
Our people are at the heart of our solutions. They reflect the communities we live in and the world where we do business. Their diversity is our strength. We’re a community of relentless problem solvers that offers the daily opportunity to contribute with your perspective, transform industries and shape the future. Our purpose is simple - to deliver a sustainable future for the world through science and collaboration. If you’re looking for a challenge and meaningful role, you’re in the right place.
  
  
**About You And This Role**
As the
**Total Rewards Operations Leader/Benefits Manager**
based in Navi Mumbai, you will establish and lead the Mumbai-based Global Total Rewards Operations Hub, delivering compensation and benefits processes across all regions. You will build a high-performing team and scalable operating model that ensures operational excellence, compliance, service quality, and a consistent employee experience through strong governance, controls, service management, and knowledge practices.
  
  
Working autonomously, you will partner with the Global Total Rewards Service Delivery Manager to improve and simplify processes, increase scalability, and advance a globally integrated Total Rewards delivery model.
  
  
You will combine deep compensation and benefits expertise with strong operational leadership and people development skills to independently lead a high-performing global service organization.

* Establish Governance and Controls: design and implement operational controls, quality assurance mechanisms, and escalation frameworks. Ensure audit readiness and compliance with established requirements.
* Build Knowledge Management Capability: establish and maintain comprehensive process documentation and work instructions. Ensure operational knowledge is captured, governed, and continuously updated.
* Lead and Develop the Team: manage and develop a team of individual contributors, while building a culture of accountability, ownership, and continuous improvement. Build capabilities required to support future growth and expanded scope.
* Operationalize New Processes: transition appropriate activities into the Mumbai hub. Ensure successful onboarding of new global processes and drive disciplined change adoption and operational readiness.
* Partner on Continuous Improvement: work closely with the Global Total Rewards Service Delivery Manager to refine operational workflows. Provide operational insight and execution expertise to process improvement initiatives. Support automation and simplification efforts.

**Qualifications**
:
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree in human resources, Business Administration, Finance, Economics, Industrial Engineering, or a related field.
* Fluent English communication skills (written and verbal).
* A minimum of 10-12 years of HR experience with at least 7 + years relevant experience in Total Rewards

**Below qualification will be added advantage:**

* Previous Global Business Services (GBS) leadership experience.
* Experience creating or managing an HR operations hub.
* Exposure to multiple regions (NA, LA, EMEAI)

* HR Operations Management: Builds operating models, governance, controls, and service performance with disciplined execution.
* Transformation Capability: Builds new teams, leads change, standardizes operations, and turns ambiguity into structured solutions.
* Process Improvement: Promotes service quality and continuous improvement.
* Interpersonal Communication: Communicates clearly and negotiates effectively.
* Critical Thinking: Analyzes data and situations, recommends solutions, and leads implementation.
* Stakeholder Management: Partners effectively with regional Total Rewards, HR Operations, Payroll, and global service delivery leaders.

**Additional Notes**

* Relocation Assistance is not available for this position.
* The ability to accommodate with international time zone is essential
* Willingness to work in the hybrid setup with 4 days from office is must

**Benefits – What Dow Offers You**
We invest in you.
  
  
Dow invests in total rewards programs to help you manage all aspects of you: your pay, your health, your life, your future, and your career. You bring your background, talent, and perspective to work every day. Dow rewards that commitment by investing in your total wellbeing.
  
  
Here are just a few highlights of what you would be offered as a Dow employee:
  
  

* Equitable and market-competitive base pay and bonus opportunity across our global markets, along with locally relevant incentives.
* Benefits and programs to support your physical, mental, financial, and social well-being, to help you get the care you need...when you need it.
* Competitive retirement program that may include company-provided benefits, savings opportunities, financial planning, and educational resources to help you achieve your long term financial-goals.

+ Employee stock purchase programs (availability varies depending on location).

* Opportunities to learn and grow through training and mentoring, work experiences, community involvement and team building.

title: HR Shared Service Specialist II
description:
**Position Summary**
Reporting to the HR Services Supervisors and/or Managers, the HR Specialist II is responsible for processing HR transactions and exceptions that are escalated from HR Specialist I.
  
  
This position is integral to the processing of end-to-end and specialized service transactions accurately and in compliance with company policies.
  
  
**Role**
The HR Specialist II plays a key role in supporting critical HR initiatives that drive the overall effectiveness of the function. In doing so, they will focus their efforts within one of the following three areas:
  
  

* HR Operations emphasis - Facilitate onboarding processes, manage data integrity, ensure compliance, and provide support for various regional HR Shared Services operations.
* Compensation emphasis - Assist with the annual compensation review, manage ad hoc compensation requests, and process one-time payments along with other regional compensation services.
* Reporting and Mass Data emphasis -Generate human capital reports, manage mass uploads, and utilize established templates for efficient data management and processing.

**Essential Functions**

* Process a wide range of employee transactions within Workday and service a wide range of requests in BMC Helix, ensuring accuracy and adherence to service level agreements.
* Manage and resolve exceptions and level 2 transactions, providing solutions to more complex employee inquiries and issues.
* Provide guidance and support to Tier 1 Specialists, acting as a point of escalation for complex cases.
* Collaborate with HR team members to identify and implement process improvements, aiming to enhance efficiency and employee experience.
* Coordinate and execute Workday transactions related to HR operations, such as job changes, personnel changes, and position management.
* Facilitate the onboarding process for new hires, ensuring all necessary paperwork is completed accurately and efficiently to promote a smooth and positive new joiner experience.
* Maintain organized and up-to-date employee files, ensuring compliance with legal and internal requirements for data privacy and protection.
* Conduct regular audits of HR processes and employee records to ensure compliance with company policies and identify areas for improvement.
* Provide training and support to Tier 1 Specialists on HR operations procedures, enhancing their ability to address employee inquiries and transactions effectively.
* Support development and maintenance of documentation and records, including knowledge of content related to areas of service emphasis and ensuring compliance with internal policies and audit requirements.
* Systematically initiate and monitor the end-to-end execution of the annual compensation review process, ensuring alignment with company policies, standards, and targets.
* Process a variety of compensation-related transactions, including salary adjustments, bonuses, and one-time payments, ensuring accuracy and compliance with established guidelines.
* Respond to employee inquiries related to compensation, providing clear and accurate information to resolve issues and enhance employee understanding.
* Maintain accurate records of compensation transactions and ensure proper documentation is in place for auditing purposes.
* Collaborate with Tier 1 Specialists to address compensation-related inquiries and provide guidance on compensation policies and procedures.
* Generate automated reports and dashboards to meet customer requests, interpreting customer needs and applying Workday knowledge to arrange and provide access to relevant insights.
* Manage mass data uploads, including EIBs (Enterprise Interface Builders), ensuring proper execution and adherence to data integrity standards, while troubleshooting issues and utilizing knowledge of Workday back-end processes.
* Respond to inquiries related to reporting and data management, providing timely and accurate information to both employees and HR team members.
* Collaborate with business stakeholders, Agency HR, and other HR team members and other stakeholders to identify opportunities for process improvements in data management and reporting, enhancing overall efficiency.

**Essential**
**EDUCATION, SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE REQUIREMENTS:**

* 4+ years of demonstrable experience managing HR Operations (running the transaction/service-oriented aspects of HR) and relevant experience leading HR Operations or HR Shared Services.
* Exhibit substantial project, program and process management skills.
* Proficient in HCM and service management platforms, software, and applications.
* Clear grasp and understanding of leading practices in HR and Shared Services operations.
* Ability to multi-task in a fast-paced and changing environment.
* Problem solving and critical thinking skills.
* Ability to manage vendors including but not limited to Technology and Software vendors, Benefits Administrators and Providers, as needed to support center operations and ensure services are provided to the organization.
* Strongly demonstrated verbal and written communication and presentation skills.

**Desirable**

* Experience effectively influencing and coaching team members.
* Project management and change management experience.
* Demonstrable experience performing complex reporting and analysis.
