title: Human Resources Executive
description:
**Human Resource Executive**

**Marol, Andheri East, Mumbai (On-site)**

**Full-time | Mon–Fri 9:30 AM–6:30 PM, Saturday WFH**

**YOE: 3–4 Years**

**About Gajab**

India bargains. E-commerce forgot.

Gajab is India's first AI-powered bargaining marketplace recreating the bazaar experience online for Tier 2/3 India. We're a fast-growing team of 30+ and building the people systems that will scale with us.

**The Role**

We're looking for an HR Executive who is equal parts organized and people-first. You'll work directly with the Sr. HR Manager and own the operational backbone of HR at Gajab recruitment coordination, candidate communication, onboarding, employee engagement, office administration, and everything in between.

This is a hands-on role in a lean HR team. Real ownership, real visibility, and a steep learning curve. If you want to understand how HR works end-to-end at a fast-moving startup from chasing candidates on WhatsApp to planning Friday game sessions this is it.

**What You'll Do**

**Candidate Communication & Recruitment Ops**

* Own daily multi-channel candidate communication calls, WhatsApp messages, and emails for all open profiles
* Maintain and update a structured candidate tracker sheet across all stages applied, screened, interviewed, offered, and joined
* Track all rolled-out offers follow up with candidates on acceptance, joining confirmation, and document submission
* Coordinate interview schedules with hiring managers and send timely reminders to candidates
* Source candidates actively via Naukri, LinkedIn, Internshala, and other relevant platform

**On boarding & Off boarding**

* Own smooth onboarding for all new hires documentation, system access, induction scheduling, and buddy assignment
* Share offer letters, appointment letters, and employment agreements
* Track probation periods and ensure confirmation letters are issued on time
* Manage exit formalities clearance checklists, relieving letters, full and final settlements, and exit interviews

**Daily HR Operations & Admin Support**

* Share daily and weekly attendance and leave updates with the Sr.People Manager
* Track employee attendance, leaves, and flag discrepancies or patterns early
* Resolve employee queries on leaves, small policy changes, and routine HR processes same day where possible
* Stay actively in touch with remote team members for check-ins, updates, and coordination
* Support the Sr. People Manager on day-to-day tasks, follow-ups, and ad hoc HR requirements

**Office & Facility Audits**

* Conduct regular housekeeping audits to ensure office cleanliness and hygiene standards are maintained
* Carry out bio metric and CCTV camera audits flag issues and coordinate with the admin team for resolution
* Maintain an audit log and share weekly status with the Sr. People Manager

**Employee Engagement & Culture**

* Track and prepare birthday and work anniversary shoutouts coordinate gifts, cards, or celebrations as applicable
* Support and execute Friday game sessions and team engagement activities end-to-end
* Coordinate employee engagement events, team outings, and cultural initiatives
* Support implementation of recognition and rewards programs
* Be the friendly first point of contact for employees for day-to-day HR queries

**Compliance & Documentation**

* Maintain accurate and up-to-date employee records and documentation
* Support monthly payroll inputs attendance, leave records, additions, and deductions
* Support audit readiness by maintaining organized and accessible HR documentation

**Performance Management L&D Support**

* Coordinate the performance review cycle schedule reviews, collect feedback, and maintain tracker
* Track probation and appraisal timelines and send timely reminders to managers
* Support training and development initiatives logistics, scheduling, and attendance tracking

**HR Reporting & MIS**

* Maintain weekly HR MIS headcount, open positions, offer tracker, and hiring pipeline
* Prepare HR dashboards and reports for the Sr. HR Manager's review

**What Success Looks Like in 60 Days**

* Candidate tracker live, updated daily, and shared with Sr. People Manager without reminders
* Zero pending offer follow-ups every rolled-out offer tracked to a clear outcome
* Attendance and leave updates shared with Sr. HR Manager every morning, consistently
* Housekeeping and biometric audits conducted on schedule with a clean log maintained
* Friday engagement sessions planned and executed with team participation
* All onboarding and offboarding documentation completed without delays

**Must Have's**

* 2–3 years of HR experience, preferably in a startup or e-commerce environment
* Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field
* Comfortable managing high-volume candidate communication daily across calls, WhatsApp, and email
* Strong organizational skills able to maintain multiple trackers and meet daily deadlines
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills warm, clear, and professional
* Proficient in MS Excel / Google Sheets comfortable building and maintaining trackers
* Ability to handle sensitive and confidential information with discretion

**Nice to Have's**

* Prior experience using HRMS tools such as Keka
* Experience coordinating employee engagement or office administration tasks
* Familiarity with Naukri Recruiter, LinkedIn Recruiter, or Internshala for active sourcing

**This Role Isn't For You If**

* You prefer a siloed role with a narrow, fixed task list
* You're not comfortable switching between recruitment, admin, and engagement tasks in the same day
* You need heavy supervision before taking initiative on routine HR tasks
* You find people-heavy, high-communication work draining rather than energizing

**Why Join Gajab**

* End-to-end HR ownership in a fast-growing startup not just one slice of the function
* Work directly with a Sr. HRBP and get exposure to strategic HR, not just operations
* Be part of building Gajab's people function and culture from the ground up
* Fast learning curve, real impact, and a team that genuinely values the HR function

**Interview Process**

* Round 1: HR Screening (20–30 min) This can be virtual call.
* Round 2: HR Ops Test – Tech round and Operational Questions
* Round 3: Sr. HR Manager Round (30–45 min) This is face to face round.

*Expected turnaround: 1 week.*

**Role purpose**
The Manager, HR Services C&B, APEC is responsible for supporting end-to-end compensation and benefits governance for Above Property across APEC. The role supports the planning and execution of annual compensation cycles, market benchmarking and analysis, reward-related reporting, payroll oversight, and benefits administration governance. Working closely with the HR Services team and C&B team, HR Business Partners, Payroll, Finance, and regional stakeholders, the role helps ensure accurate, compliant, and audit-ready compensation, benefits, and payroll processes while improving consistency, data integrity, and service delivery for Above Property associates and leaders.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Compensation & Rewards Administration
* Support the administration and governance of compensation programs for Above Property associates across APEC.
* Coordinate annual compensation processes, including merit, bonus, salary reviews, and related reward activities.
* Prepare, validate, and maintain compensation data, ensuring accuracy, confidentiality, and compliance with established controls.
* Support job evaluations, market benchmarking, salary analysis, and reward-related reporting to inform compensation decisions.
* Partner with HR Services, Business Partners, and business leaders to create and guide compensation proposals and policies.
* Benefits & Wellbeing Programs
* Support the administration and governance of benefits programs, including annual benefits review, plan design enhancements and implementation.
* Partner with benefits vendors, HR Services, and key stakeholders to ensure effective delivery of benefits programs and ongoing management of benefits programs.
* Coordinate with HR Services to ensure timely execution, accurate administration, and communication to associates regarding benefit offerings and changes.
* Support benefits-related market surveys and continuous improvement initiatives to enhance program effectiveness and associate experience.
* Payroll Governance & Compliance
* Partner with HR Services, Payroll, and Finance teams to support the accurate and timely processing of payroll-related compensation and benefits.
* Review and validate payroll inputs related to compensation, incentives, allowances, and benefits changes, ensuring accuracy and alignment with approved actions.
* Monitor payroll exceptions, discrepancies, and compliance risks, providing guidance and escalating issues as appropriate.
* Support payroll governance activities by maintaining controls, documentation, and audit readiness across compensation, benefits, and payroll processes.
* Reporting, Analytics & Data Management
* Maintain the integrity and accuracy of compensation, benefits, and payroll data.
* Analyze reward data and trends, identifying insights and opportunities to support business and HR priorities.
* Develop dashboards, metrics, and reporting tools to enhance visibility and decision-making.
* Projects, Process Improvement & Governance
* Support regional Compensation & Benefits projects, including process standardization, system enhancements, and service delivery improvements.
* Develop and maintain policies, standard operating procedures, process documentation, templates, and communication materials.
* Partner with HR Services, Payroll, Finance, and other stakeholders to drive operational excellence and process efficiency.
* Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives to enhance consistency, governance, and the associate experience across reward programs.
* Handle sensitive compensation, benefits, and payroll information with the highest level of professionalism and discretion.
* Support the end-to-end governance of compensation and benefits program processes for Above Property associates across APEC.
* Coordinate and support the planning, preparation and execution of annual compensation cycles, including merit, bonus, salary review and related reward processes.
* Prepare, validate and maintain compensation and benefits data, ensuring accuracy, completeness, confidentiality and audit readiness.
* Partner with HR Services to support market benchmarking, salary analysis and compensation-related reporting to inform decision-making and governance.
* Partner with HR Services, HR Business Partners, Payroll, Finance and other stakeholders to ensure reward-related transactions are processed accurately and on time.
* Manage payroll oversight activities for Above Property populations within scope, including recurring payroll inputs, validation, issue resolution and follow-up with payroll providers or internal teams.
* Support benefits administration governance, including coordination of benefit changes, eligibility reviews, associate communications and annual or recurring benefits activities.
* Maintain strong controls and documentation for compensation, benefits and payroll processes, ensuring compliance with company policies, approval requirements and applicable local requirements.
* Identify data discrepancies, process risks or compliance concerns and ensure timely escalation, follow-up and resolution.
* Prepare reports, dashboards, workforce and reward information for HR Services, C&B and business stakeholders.
* Support regional HR Services and C&B projects, including process standardization, system improvements, policy implementation and service delivery enhancements.
* Develop and maintain standard operating procedures, process guides, templates and associate or manager communications related to compensation, benefits and payroll activities.
* Contribute to improved consistency, efficiency and quality across reward-related HR Services processes.
* Handle confidential and sensitive compensation, benefits and payroll information with appropriate discretion and professionalism.
* Perform any other duties and responsibilities as reasonably assigned or instructed by the business from time to time.

**Required Skills And Experience**

* Relevant experience in compensation and benefits, payroll, HR operations, HR shared services or a similar role supporting reward and associate-lifecycle processes.
* Good working knowledge of compensation, benefits and payroll processes, with the ability to support annual cycles, recurring activities and operational delivery.
* Experience working with HR, payroll or compensation data, including validation, reporting, reconciliation and issue resolution.
* Ability to manage recurring processes accurately and within agreed timelines, including compensation reviews, payroll inputs, benefits administration and audit requirements.
* Experience supporting multiple countries, markets or stakeholders in a regional environment.
* Strong attention to detail and ability to maintain accurate, complete and confidential records.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to explain compensation, benefits and payroll requirements clearly to different audiences.
* Well organized and able to manage multiple priorities across markets, deadlines and recurring operational cycles.
* High level of proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Power BI, PowerPoint, and other Microsoft Office applications and reporting tools, with experience in data analysis, dashboard creation, tracking, and preparing management presentation decks and information.
* Ability to deliver presentations to Business Partners and other key stakeholders

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 5-8 years' experience supporting regional compensation cycles, salary benchmarking, benefits administration or payroll governance.
* Experience working in a regional HR Services, C&B or shared services environment.
* Strong service orientation and stakeholder-management capability.
* Sound judgement and discretion when handling sensitive reward, payroll and associate information.
* Ability to manage competing priorities across countries and time zones.
* Strong attention to detail, organization and follow-through.
* Clear written and verbal communication.

title: Head of Human Resources
description:
**Position Purpose**

The Head HR will be responsible for developing and executing the people strategy that enables Companies India & Global growth ambitions while fostering a high-performance, employee-centric, safety-first culture.

The role will serve as a strategic advisor to the CEO and leadership team on organization design, talent acquisition, leadership development, employee engagement, industrial relations, performance management, rewards, succession planning, culture transformation, and workforce productivity across corporate, manufacturing, projects, service, and O&M operations.

The incumbent will play a pivotal role in positioning company as an employer of choice within the renewable energy industry while ensuring strong governance, compliance, and workforce capability to support long-term business success.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Strategic HR Leadership**

* Develop and implement an HR strategy aligned with Companies business objectives and growth plans.
* Partner with the CEO and leadership team on organizational effectiveness and workforce planning.
* Drive culture initiatives focused on accountability, ownership, collaboration, innovation, and customer orientation.
* Lead organizational transformation and change management programs.

**Talent Acquisition & Workforce Planning**

* Develop robust manpower plans to support manufacturing expansion, project execution, service growth, and new business initiatives.
* Build strong recruitment pipelines for leadership, engineering, manufacturing, project execution, sales, and service functions.
* Strengthen employer brand in the renewable energy sector.
* Reduce time-to-hire while improving quality of hires and retention.

**Leadership Development & Succession Planning**

* Establish leadership development frameworks for future business leaders.
* Build succession plans for all critical positions.
* Design career progression and talent acceleration programs.
* Drive coaching and mentoring initiatives across the organization.

**Performance & Productivity Management**

* Lead performance management processes across the organization.
* Ensure alignment between business objectives and individual KPIs.
* Introduce data-driven productivity and performance measurement systems.
* Drive continuous improvement and accountability culture.

**Employee Engagement & Culture**

* Enhance employee satisfaction, engagement, and retention.
* Lead employee listening forums, surveys, and engagement initiatives.
* Promote a culture where employees feel respected, valued, and empowered.
* Champion diversity, inclusion, and employee well-being initiatives.

**Compensation, Benefits & Rewards**

* Design and implement competitive compensation and rewards programs.
* Conduct benchmarking against leading renewable energy, engineering, and manufacturing companies.
* Develop retention and recognition programs for high-potential employees.
* Support merit reviews and incentive plans linked to business performance.

**Industrial Relations & Employee Relations**

* Maintain harmonious industrial relations across manufacturing operations.
* Ensure proactive engagement with employees and stakeholders.
* Drive grievance handling and conflict resolution mechanisms.
* Support business continuity through effective workforce relations.

**Learning & Capability Building**

* Establish technical and leadership competency frameworks.
* Drive capability development programs across manufacturing, engineering, supply chain, project execution, EHS, and O&M.
* Ensure training programs align with future business requirements.
* Create a learning culture focused on continuous development.

**Compliance & Governance**

* Ensure compliance with all applicable labour laws and statutory regulations.
* Lead POSH, ethics, disciplinary, and employee governance processes.
* Support internal and external audits.
* Maintain robust HR policies, procedures, and controls.

**HR Digitization & Analytics**

* Drive digital HR transformation initiatives.
* Develop leadership dashboards for workforce analytics.
* Establish data-driven decision-making through HR metrics and insights.
* Improve HR process effectiveness and employee experience through automation.

**Education**

* MBA / PGDM in Human Resources from a reputed institution.
* Additional qualifications in Labour Law, Organization Development, Coaching, Industrial Relations, or Compensation Management preferred.

**Experience**

• 18+ years of progressive Human Resources leadership experience, with a strong track record of driving organizational effectiveness and people strategy.

• Minimum 5 years in a senior HR leadership role with enterprise-wide responsibility for talent, culture, organizational development, employee relations, and workforce planning.

• Demonstrated success in leading organizational growth, transformation, change management, and culture-building initiatives.

• Proven experience managing large and geographically dispersed workforces across multiple business functions and locations.

• Strong expertise in leadership development, succession planning, talent management, performance management, and employee engagement.

• Exposure to complex, multi-site, project-driven, manufacturing, engineering, or service organizations is advantageous but not mandatory.

title: Recruitment Specialist
description:
We are hiring Recruitment Specialist in RPO setup. The candidate will be deployed at cliental site taking care of end-to-end recruitment. Below is the JD for your reference.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. 360-Degree End-to-End Recruitment**

* Manage the complete recruitment lifecycle, from understanding hiring requirements and sourcing candidates to screening, interview coordination, offer negotiation, and joining follow-ups.
* Conduct detailed requirement briefing discussions with hiring managers to understand job specifications, competencies, and business expectations.
* Source relevant profiles through job portals, LinkedIn, employee referrals, internal databases, and other sourcing channels.
* Screen and assess candidates based on role requirements, experience, skills, compensation, and cultural fit.
* Maintain a healthy candidate pipeline and ensure timely submission of quality profiles.
* Drive interview scheduling, feedback collection, offer management, and candidate engagement throughout the hiring process.
* Follow up with selected candidates to ensure offer acceptance and successful joining.
* Manage multiple open positions simultaneously while meeting defined recruitment SLAs and turnaround times.

**2. Stakeholder Management**

* Act as the primary point of contact for assigned hiring stakeholders and maintain effective working relationships.
* Proactively communicate recruitment progress, challenges, pipeline status, and anticipated delays.
* Drive timely interview feedback and decision-making from hiring managers.
* Understand changing business priorities and realign recruitment efforts accordingly.
* Manage stakeholder expectations regarding candidate availability, compensation benchmarks, and market realities.
* Identify potential hiring bottlenecks and proactively recommend solutions.
* Ensure a professional and seamless experience for both clients and candidates.

**3. Recruitment MIS and Excel Management**

* Maintain recruitment trackers with
  **100% accuracy and real-time updates**
  on candidate and position status.
* Prepare and maintain daily, weekly, and monthly recruitment MIS reports and dashboards.
* Track key recruitment metrics, including open positions, profiles sourced, submissions, interviews, offers, closures, joining ratios, and position ageing.
* Monitor individual productivity, recruitment funnel movement, and progress against assigned targets.
* Use MS Excel to analyse recruitment data, identify gaps, and generate actionable insights.
* Ensure data integrity, timely reporting, and adherence to client-specific reporting formats and processes.

**4. Recruitment Delivery and Process Compliance**

* Ensure recruitment delivery is aligned with agreed SLAs, client expectations, and quality benchmarks.
* Regularly review open positions and prioritise requirements based on business criticality.
* Maintain accurate candidate records in the Applicant Tracking System (ATS) and recruitment trackers.
* Ensure compliance with recruitment processes, documentation requirements, and client-specific guidelines.
* Continuously identify opportunities to improve sourcing effectiveness, turnaround time, and recruitment productivity.

**Required Skills and Competencies**

* Strong hands-on experience in 360-degree end-to-end recruitment.
* Excellent stakeholder management, client communication, and relationship-building skills.
* Good proficiency in MS Excel, including
  **VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, Pivot Tables, IF formulas, filters, sorting, and data management**
  .
* Experience in recruitment MIS, dashboards, and tracker management.
* Proficiency in sourcing through job portals, LinkedIn, Boolean search, referrals, and databases.
* Strong candidate assessment, negotiation, and follow-up skills.
* Ability to manage multiple requirements and changing priorities in a fast-paced environment.
* Strong ownership, attention to detail, time management, and problem-solving abilities.
* Familiarity with ATS and recruitment management systems.

**Educational Qualification and Experience**

* Graduate in any discipline; MBA/PGDM in Human Resources will be an added advantage.
* 3–6 years of relevant recruitment experience, preferably in an RPO or client-facing recruitment environment.
* Demonstrated experience in managing the complete recruitment lifecycle independently.
* Prior experience handling client stakeholders and recruitment MIS is essential.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* Achievement of assigned hiring targets and recruitment SLAs.
* Quality and relevance of candidate submissions.
* Time-to-fill and position closure rate.
* Offer-to-join ratio and candidate engagement.
* Stakeholder satisfaction and timely feedback management.
* Accuracy and timeliness of recruitment trackers and MIS reports.
* Individual recruiter productivity and process compliance.

**● Budget: 3 - 6 LPA**

We’re looking for a proactive and people-centric HR Executive who enjoys building culture, strengthening HR processes, and creating meaningful teammate experiences. ● Ensure a smooth and engaging candidate experience throughout the recruitment journey.

● Generate recruitment reports and track hiring metrics such as TAT, source effectiveness, pipeline status, and closures.

● Support employer branding initiatives, walk-ins, campus hiring, and recruitment campaigns.

**Onboarding & Teammate Experience**

● Create seamless onboarding experiences for new joiners from pre-joining communication to induction and assimilation.

● Coordinate onboarding formalities including documentation, HRMS updates, welcome kits, policy orientation, and stakeholder alignment.

● Ensure new teammates experience a smooth transition into the organization and team culture.

● Drive engagement touchpoints during the initial months to improve retention and overall experience.

● Actively contribute towards creating a positive, inclusive, and teammate-friendly workplace culture.

**Teammate Engagement & Culture Building**

● Act as a culture custodian by driving initiatives that strengthen team bonding, collaboration, and morale.

● Plan and execute engagement activities, celebrations, rewards & recognition initiatives, festive events, and team-building programs.

● Coordinate initiatives around wellness, learning, fun activities, and internal communication.

● Support leadership and HR in building a high-performance yet empathetic work culture.

● Gather teammate feedback and contribute ideas to improve workplace practices and overall experience.

**HR Operations, Payroll & Compliance**

● Coordinate monthly payroll inputs in collaboration with finance/payroll vendors ensuring accuracy and timely processing.

● Manage records related to attendance, leaves, compensation, documentation, and statutory compliance.

● Efficiently manage and maintain HRMS platforms ensuring accurate teammate data and process tracking.

● Support implementation and streamlining of HR policies, processes, and documentation.

● Prepare HR reports and dashboards related to attendance, attrition, hiring, engagement, payroll, and people analytics.

● Assist in HR audits, documentation reviews, and process improvements.

Offboarding & Teammate Lifecycle Management

● Maintain proper documentation and records related to separations.

● Capture feedback and insights from exits to support organizational improvements and retention strategies.

**Administrative & HR Support**

● Maintain organized HR documentation, records, and confidential information with high accuracy.

● Coordinate internal HR meetings, reviews, and organizational initiatives.

● Provide day-to-day HR support to teammates across departments.

● Support execution of company-wide events, internal initiatives, and people-focused programs.

● Excellent communication skills

● Bachelor’s degree in HR, MMS/MBA/PG in HR or a related field.

● 1 – 5 years of experience in HR operations, Talent Acquisition, onboarding, payroll coordination, or similar HR roles.

● Good understanding of HR operations, teammate lifecycle management, payroll coordination, and labour law basics.

● Strong communication, coordination, and stakeholder management skills.

● Proficiency in MS Office and HR systems/software.

● Strong organizational skills with attention to detail and process orientation.

● Ability to handle confidential information with professionalism and discretion.

● A proactive mindset with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

 Powai, Mumbai

 DJRS Hospitality LLP
 



**Department:** 
 Human Resources
 



**Employment Type:** 
 Full\-Time
 



**Experience:** 
 0–2 Years

 HR Manager / Head of Human Resources
 


 About DJRS Hospitality LLP
 
 DJRS Hospitality LLP is a growing hospitality company building and operating a diverse portfolio of restaurants, cafés, cloud kitchens, catering, events, and experiential concepts across Mumbai.
 



 As we continue to grow, we are looking for an enthusiastic and organised
 **Human Resource Associate** 
 to join our HR team and gain hands\-on exposure to various aspects of Human Resources.
 



 This is a great opportunity for a
 **fresher or an early\-career HR professional** 
 who wants to build a strong foundation in HR while working in a fast\-paced hospitality environment.
 


 About the Role
 
 As a Human Resource Associate, you will support the HR team across
 **recruitment, onboarding, HR administration, employee engagement, payroll coordination, employee queries, documentation, and day\-to\-day HR operations.** 




 You will work closely with the HR team, employees, HODs, outlet managers, Finance, and Operations, giving you practical exposure to the complete employee lifecycle.
 



 We are looking for someone who is
 **eager to learn, comfortable interacting with people, organised with their work, and willing to take ownership as they grow into the role.** 



 Key ResponsibilitiesRecruitment \& Hiring
 * Assist with end\-to\-end recruitment for various corporate and operational positions.

* Screen CVs and shortlist candidates based on role requirements.

* Follow up with candidates regarding interviews, assignments, feedback, and joining timelines.
* Maintain recruitment trackers and provide regular hiring updates.

* Support recruitment requirements for new outlets and pre\-opening projects.


 Joining \& Onboarding
 * Coordinate joining formalities for new employees and interns.
* Collect and maintain required employee documents.
* Update employee information in HR records and systems.
* Assist in conducting employee induction and orientation programmes.
* Support employee transfers, promotions, increments, and other employee movements.
* Maintain records of new joiners, active employees, and resigned employees.
* Assist with exit formalities and Full \& Final Settlement documentation.


 HR Operations \& Payroll Support
 * Assist with monthly payroll preparation and coordination with Finance.
* Update attendance, salary, deductions, incentives, increments, and other payroll inputs.
* Assist in preparing salary working and payout sheets.
* Support service charge\-related workings and employee data.
* Assist employees with basic queries related to salary, payslips, attendance, leave, and other HR matters.
* Maintain employee registers, trackers, and HR records.
* Assist with HRMS and payroll systems such as Facto HR.
* Support the HR team with PF, ESIC, Professional Tax, and other statutory documentation and requirements.


 Employee Relations \& Engagement
 * Act as a point of contact for employees for routine HR\-related queries.
* Assist in resolving employee concerns by coordinating with the appropriate HR or operational stakeholders.
* Interact with employees and outlet teams to understand their concerns and requirements.
* Assist in organising employee engagement activities and celebrations.
* Support Employee of the Month and employee recognition initiatives.
* Assist with outlet visits and employee interactions when required.


 HR Administration \& Documentation
 * Prepare and maintain HR documents such as offer letters, increment letters, warning letters, certificates, and other employee documentation.
* Maintain accurate and organised employee files and HR records.
* Assist with employment verification and other employee\-related documentation.
* Support HR policy communication and distribution.
* Maintain leave, attendance, and employee movement records.
* Handle employee information with confidentiality and professionalism.


 HR Systems \& Process Support
 * Maintain HR trackers, employee masters, and reporting sheets.
* Work with
 **MS Excel and Google Sheets** 
 for day\-to\-day HR activities.
* Assist in maintaining and improving HR trackers and templates.
* Support the HR team in implementing simple process improvements and automations.
* Learn and work with HRMS and other digital HR tools.
* Prepare basic HR reports and data for internal review.


 What We're Looking For
 
 We are looking for someone who is:
 


* Eager to build a career in Human Resources.
* Comfortable communicating with people at different levels.
* Organised and attentive to detail.
* Comfortable working with numbers, spreadsheets, and employee data.
* Willing to learn new HR systems and processes.
* Proactive and willing to take responsibility for assigned tasks.
* Good at following up and ensuring tasks are completed on time.
* Comfortable working in a fast\-paced hospitality environment.
* Professional, approachable, and able to maintain confidentiality.
* A team player with a positive and learning\-oriented attitude.


 Qualifications \& Experience

 **Human Resources, Business Administration, Hospitality Management, or a related field.**

 **0–2 years of experience** 
 in HR, recruitment, administration, hospitality, retail, or a similar environment are encouraged to apply.

title: Business Performance Manager
description:
**Location Country** 
 India
   

  

**Work Location** 
 Mumbai
   

  

**Who are V?** 
 As a global leader in ship management and marine services, we add value to a vessel’s operations. Operating around the clock and around the world, V. gives every client the quality and efficiency they need in every sector. Covering crew management and recruitment, quality ship management and technical services, together with supporting management and commercial services, V. has an unrivalled industry knowledge with performance assured. Our values, We Care, We Collaborate, We Challenge, We are Consistent, We Commit and Deliver, are at the heart of everything we do and they support our strategy of Investing in Talent. We are always interested in making contact with talented individuals \- people who will demonstrate our values and deliver great service, for internal and external stakeholders.
   

  

**Overall Purpose of The Job**
* The Business Performance Manager is responsible for analyzing business performance data, identifying improvement opportunities, and driving initiatives to enhance overall efficiency, and strategic alignment. This role collaborates with cross\-functional teams to implement performance management frameworks, track KPIs, and support data\-driven decision\-making across the group.


**Key Responsibilities And Tasks**
**Strategy \& Operational Planning**
* Support strategic planning \& annual goal setting for various departments across different business units.
* Align performance metrics with strategic objectives of the business.


**Performance Analysis \& Reporting**
* Develop and manage key performance indicators and dashboards to monitor business performance.
* Improve Reporting through simplification, standardization and automation.
* Utilizing data from wide range of sources to analyze and identify possible impacts on the business.
* Analyze trends, and opportunities across business units to provide actionable insights.
* Preparing regular performance reports and findings for the business.


**Project \& Change Management**
* Support performance / process improvement initiatives or projects across departments.
* Monitor and evaluate success of initiatives or projects and adjust plans as needed.


**Communication**
* Facilitate regular performance review meetings.
* Being able to communicate performance insights to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders and audiences.


**Leadership \& Direction**
* Organizing the work of the team: planning and prioritizations, negotiations with the stakeholders.
* Develop and propose own performance objectives; take appropriate actions to ensure achievement of agreed objectives, using the organization's performance management systems to improve personal performance.
* Set appropriate performance objectives for direct reports, taking appropriate corrective action where necessary to ensure the achievement of team/personal objectives.
* Use the organization's formal development framework to identify the team's individual development needs. Plan and implement actions to build their capabilities. Provide training or coaching to others throughout the organization in own area of expertise to enable others to improve performance and fulfill personal potential.


**What can I expect in return?** 
 V. Group can offer you a market leading salary and benefits package, in addition to significant opportunities for career growth and personal development. This a great opportunity to join a true leader in the maritime sector \- a company that has exciting plans for future growth.
   

  

**Essential**
* Bachelor’s degree in Statistics, Data Science, Computer Science, Mathematics, or a related field.
* 5\+ years of experience in business performance management, strategy, or a related field.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Proficiency in Business Intelligence tools (e.g., Excel, Power BI, Tableau).
* SQL – For querying databases and extracting performance data.
* Data Visualization – Presenting insights clearly to various stakeholders.
* Experience in Project Management Tools (e.g., Asana, Microsoft DevOps, Jira).
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Experience with performance management frameworks (e.g., OKRs, Balanced Scorecard) is a plus.
* Strong understanding of financial modeling, forecasting, and performance tracking.
* Experience in automation, digitization and other technology\-driven improvement projects


**General Technical Proficiency**
* Experience with presentation tools (e.g., Powerpoint, Google Slides, Canva)
* CRM Platforms
* Collaboration Tools (e.g.,MS Teams, Slack, Sharepoint)


**Desirable**
* MA degree
* Lean 6 Sigma certified
* Project Management (PMP/Prince 2\) certified
* With shipping and maritime industry experience


**Applications Close Date**

title: Human Resources Consultant
description:
We're looking for an HR / OD Consultant. But not the "write a policy manual" kind.
 



 This is a 4\-month project assignment. It is not a permanent position.
 



  





 At SHANBHAGS, we are in the middle of an important internal transformation.
 



 The vision is clear. The intent is clear. Now comes the harder part: making it real.
 



 Because organisations do not change because a presentation says they should. They change when intent translates into clear behaviours, operating disciplines, systems and SOPs that people can actually follow — and managers can actually manage.
 



  





 We are looking for a senior HR / Organisation Development Consultant who has done this before — at scale. Someone who can understand the organisation, work closely with leadership and employees, and help build the frameworks and SOPs that make the transformation live every day.
 



 Not just define what should happen. Design it. Implement it. Make it stick.
 



  





 You should bring:
 


* 10–15\+ years of serious HR / OD experience
* Proven experience designing AND successfully implementing organisation\-wide SOPs, operating frameworks and people/culture systems
* Experience working with large and complex organisations
* Ability to translate organisational intent into specific, practical, measurable and repeatable behaviours and processes
* Strong experience across performance management, capability building, accountability, leadership, cross\-functional working, employee development and culture implementation
* The ability to work with leadership while understanding what actually happens on the ground
* A healthy intolerance for beautifully written documents that collapse the minute real life begins



 One thing matters enormously: You must have implemented what you designed.
 



  





 This is not recruitment. Not an HR audit. Not policy polishing. And certainly not another employee handbook nobody reads. It is about helping us build the operating DNA for the next phase of Shanbhag Engineering Company.
 



  





 We also welcome former CHROs, HR Heads and senior OD leaders who may have stepped away from full\-time corporate life but still enjoy solving difficult organisational problems. Perhaps you no longer want the title or a 9\-to\-9 — but still miss rolling up your sleeves once in a while. For someone like that, this could be a very satisfying four months — a chance to solve a real organisational problem and build something that lasts well beyond the assignment.
 



  





 Interested? Write directly to hr@shanbhags.com with:
 


* A brief profile and relevant work experience
* One organisation\-wide system / transformation you designed and successfully implemented
* Your expected professional fee for the 4\-month assignment



  





 Learn more about us at https://shanbhags.com

title: Learning ,Development and Wellness Executive
description:

 Learning and Development

* Liaise with external training partners and vendors for capability\-building interventions

title: Learning and Development Manager
company: Subko Specialty Coffee Roasters, Bakehouse and Fine Cacao
description:
**Company Description** 
 Subko Specialty Coffee Roasters, Bakehouse and Fine Cacao is a purpose\-driven brand spotlighting specialty coffee, elevated baking, and fine cacao from the Indian Subcontinent. The company combines traditional “daily bread” culture with innovative, risk\-taking flavor profiles, crafting distinctive coffees, breads, viennoiserie, and cacao products. Subko’s mission is to build a genuinely Asian specialty coffee and cacao movement and represent the region on a global platform. Through a “Cherry to Cup,” “Crop to Craft,” and “Pod to Bar” ethos, Subko focuses on meticulous sourcing, processing, and production to set new quality standards. The team is driven by craft, curiosity, and a commitment to reshaping how people experience coffee, bakehouse offerings, and cacao.
   

**Role Description** 
 The Learning and Development Manager is a full\-time, on\-site role based in Mumbai, responsible for designing and leading learning initiatives across Subko’s coffee, bakehouse, and cacao operations. This role oversees the end\-to\-end learning lifecycle, including needs analysis, program design, delivery, and evaluation for both frontline and corporate team members. Day\-to\-day responsibilities include creating training curricula, facilitating workshops and on\-the\-job training, managing learning content and systems, and partnering with managers to build role\-specific capabilities. The Learning and Development Manager will collaborate closely with leadership to develop talent pipelines, support performance and leadership development, and ensure training aligns with Subko’s craft\-focused culture and growth plans. The role also involves monitoring training effectiveness, maintaining learning documentation, and continuously improving learning strategies based on feedback and operational metrics.
   

**Qualifications**
* Candidates should possess strong skills in Training \& Development and Learning Management to design, implement, and track comprehensive learning programs.
* Candidates should possess skills in Training and Instructional Design to create engaging, role\-relevant content and deliver effective in\-person sessions.
* Candidates should possess skills in Leadership Development to support manager capability\-building, succession planning, and talent growth.
* Experience with hospitality, food \& beverage, specialty coffee, or retail environments is beneficial.
* Strong communication, facilitation, and stakeholder management abilities, with a collaborative, hands\-on working style.
* Proven experience in a Learning and Development or similar HR role, preferably 4–7 years, with responsibility for end\-to\-end training programs.
* Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Education, Business, Psychology, or a related field; relevant certifications in L\&D or instructional design are an advantage.
* Comfort working on\-site in a fast\-paced, craft\-driven environment and aligning learning initiatives with business goals and brand values.

 We are looking for candidates with 6\+ years of experience in the Workday HCM product suite and strong expertise in Workday reporting, dashboard development, and data analytics, including experience with Power BI and/or Workday Prism Analytics. * Reporting, Dashboards, and Data Analytics: Design and deliver advanced Workday reports and dashboards, leveraging calculated fields, matrix and composite reports, and Power Bi and/or Workday Prism Analytics to integrate and analyze data from multiple sources. Provide actionable insights and recommendations to support management and executive decision\-making, with a strong emphasis on talent and workforce analytics.
* Manage Organizational Changes: Oversee complex organizational changes within Workday, providing advanced functional support for issues and ensuring smooth transitions.
* Integrations Management: Support inbound and outbound Workday integrations, including design, testing, troubleshooting, and ensuring data integrity across systems.
* Security and Compliance: Provide primary security administration and IT audit support, ensuring compliance with internal policies and best practices.
* Enhancements and Testing: Configure enhancements or changes in Workday HRIS and lead comprehensive testing cycles, actively reviewing new functionalities to ensure optimal performance.
* Client Support: Offer backup support for the HR Service Center by responding to escalated client\-service requests, ensuring high\-quality service delivery.


**Candidate Requirements**
* Excellent research, analytical, and critical thinking skills, with the ability to leverage data to influence decision\-making.
* Proven experience in building Workday dashboards and delivering data insights; hands\-on experience with Power BI and/or Workday Prism Analytics strongly preferred.
* Strong project, prioritization, \& time management skills – ability to handle multiple priorities, organize work and meet deadlines.
* Demonstrated ability to drive efforts to standardize, optimize, and simplify processes and technical solutions.


**Core Values**
* Demonstrates integrity and discretion in handling sensitive information, ensuring strict confidentiality at all times.
* Strong interpersonal, oral, and written communication and collaboration skills with all levels of management
* Strong organizational skills including the ability to adapt to shifting priorities and meet frequent deadlines,
* Demonstrated proactive approach to problem\-solving with strong judgment and decision\-making capability.
* Highly resourceful and collaborative team\-player, with the ability to also be independently effective and exude initiative and a sense of urgency.
* Exemplifies our customer\-focused, action\-oriented, results\-driven culture.
* Forward looking thinker, who actively seeks opportunities, has a desire for continuous learning, and proposes solutions.
* Dedicated to the firm’s values of non\-negotiable integrity, valuing our people, exceeding client expectations, and embracing intellectual curiosity and rigor.

 Job Category
   

  

 Customer Success
   

  

 Job Details

 Salesforce is the \#1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life.  As a Manager, Human\-Centered Change Management, you will serve as a strategic advisor, partnering with Salesforce customers to optimize platform value realization through the design and implementation of change strategies that prioritize the human aspect of transformative change. Working collaboratively with customers and Salesforce delivery teams, you will drive impactful team dynamics, cultivate awareness, and secure alignment with a unified change vision. * Partner with customers to develop and execute comprehensive change management strategies aligned with organizational goals and Salesforce platform implementation.

**Proactive Engagement And Team Building**
* Proactively foster high\-impact team dynamics, building awareness and securing buy\-in for shared change objectives.
* Collaborate closely with customers and Salesforce delivery teams to ensure alignment and commitment to the change vision.


**Key Change Management Initiatives**

* Facilitate the integration of change management processes into Salesforce.com projects.
* Work closely with Salesforce.com administrators, BAs, Solutions Architects and developers to understand system changes and ensure alignment with change management strategies.
* Support team upskilling in user experience principles to strengthen collaboration with design teams and improve the effectiveness of training, communications, and adoption strategies.


**Qualifications**
* Prosci Certification or equivalent is mandatory, with demonstrated expertise in change management and training within the context of technology implementations. Salesforce experience is highly desirable.

**Education**
* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Information Technology, or a related field is required. A Master's degree is considered advantageous.

 The Manager, Human\-Centered Change Management, is a pivotal leader who drives transformative change within organizations by prioritizing the human aspect of change and ensuring alignment with organizational goals and Salesforce platform capabilities.  Unleash Your Potential

title: Fleet Personnel Officer
description:
Seaspan employees are goal\-driven and thrive in a high\-performance culture. Our integrated business model, with over 25 years of fleet life\-cycle management expertise, provides the world’s major shipping companies with long\-term leases on large, modern and technologically advanced vessels, combined with industry\-leading ship management services. As owner and operator of the vessels, we provide skilled officers and crews dedicated to the safe, reliable, and economical operation of our fleet. Seaspan's fleet has evolved over time to meet the varying needs of our customer base. We own vessels in a wide range of sizes, from 2,500 TEU to 24,000 TEU. Our main operating offices are located in Singapore, Vancouver, Hong Kong, and Mumbai.
   

  

**Position Summary**
 The Fleet Personnel Officer provides comprehensive communication, project coordination, executive and administrative support to the Head of Fleet Personnel. The role is responsible for managing high\-volume correspondence, coordinating departmental projects, monitoring actions and deliverables, and supporting the effective functioning of the Head of Fleet Personnel’s office.
   

  

 The position also supports departmental reporting, governance, seafarer welfare initiatives, union and CBA administration, forums, travel and selected operational matters. It requires a high degree of discretion, sound judgement, attention to detail and the ability to remain responsive while coordinating with senior leaders, Fleet Personnel teams, vessels, seafarers, manning partners, unions, vendors and other stakeholders across different time zones.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Email, Communication and Correspondence Management: 20%
* Manage and organise the Head of Fleet Personnel’s high\-volume email correspondence, ensuring messages are reviewed, prioritised and directed appropriately.
* Identify matters requiring immediate attention, follow\-up, delegation or escalation, and maintain visibility of pending responses and commitments.
* Draft, proofread and coordinate emails, letters, memos, presentations and other communications on behalf of the Head of Fleet Personnel.
* Prepare standard departmental letters, invitation letters, confirmations and authorisation documents, and maintain appropriate records.
* Coordinate with internal and external stakeholders to obtain timely inputs and ensure correspondence is closed out accurately and professionally.
* Handle confidential, sensitive and privileged information with discretion.
* Project Coordination and Action Management: 20%
* Coordinate Fleet Personnel projects and improvement initiatives by maintaining project plans, milestones, actions, risks, decisions and deliverables.
* Proactively follow up with responsible stakeholders, identify potential delays and provide concise progress updates to the Head of Fleet Personnel.
* Coordinate user inputs, testing, communications and implementation follow\-up for Fleet Personnel systems and digitalisation initiatives, including COMPAS and related crew\-management processes.
* Support the preparation of project briefs, presentations, status reports, process guidance, memos and rollout communications.
* Liaise with IT, Finance, HR, Training, regional teams and other functions to resolve dependencies and support timely delivery.
* Remain responsive to urgent project requirements and changing priorities arising from Seaspan’s global operations.
* Meetings, Minutes and Follow\-up Coordination: 10%
* Coordinate meeting logistics and prepare agendas, briefing notes and supporting materials for departmental, management and external stakeholder meetings.
* Record and circulate clear minutes of meetings and maintain action trackers with owners and target dates.
* Follow up on overdue actions and provide the Head of Fleet Personnel with timely updates on progress and outstanding matters.
* Coordinate the Fleet Personnel weekly meeting agenda and consolidate inputs from departmental and regional teams.
* Support meetings across time zones when operationally required.
* Reporting, Dashboards and Management Information: 10%
* Prepare and maintain periodic reports, dashboards, management information and KPI trackers for the Head of Fleet Personnel.
* Gather and consolidate information from Fleet Personnel teams and company systems into structured summaries for leadership review.
* Support monthly management reporting, budget coordination, variance commentary and ad hoc analysis.
* Maintain accurate records of departmental actions, incidents, recognition, policy exceptions and other agreed metrics.
* Work accurately under tight timelines while managing multiple reporting requirements concurrently.
* CBA, Wage Scale, Vessel Data and Union Coordination: 10%
* Maintain trackers for Collective Bargaining Agreement renewals, vessel enrolments, correspondence and supporting documentation.
* Maintain controlled vessel and CBA data, including business unit, shipowner, flag, complement and applicable wage arrangements.
* Support the preparation, issue and recordkeeping of approved wage scales and related Fleet Personnel memoranda.
* Coordinate routine documentation and follow\-up with unions, manning partners and internal stakeholders under the guidance of the Head of Fleet Personnel.
* Compliance, Audit and Document Control: 8%
* Support ISO, RPSL and other Fleet Personnel audit preparations, including document collection, tracker maintenance and closure of agreed actions.
* Assist with updates to departmental manuals, procedures, records and controlled documents.
* Maintain organised and secure digital and physical filing systems for the Head of Fleet Personnel’s office.
* Ensure records are complete, current, readily retrievable and handled in accordance with company confidentiality and data\-protection requirements.
* Seafarer Welfare, Insurance and Recognition Programmes: 7%
* Coordinate administrative aspects of seafarer medical and life\-insurance programmes, including data updates, supporting documentation and follow\-up with service providers.
* Support humanitarian\-aid and other urgent seafarer welfare arrangements as directed.
* Administer long\-service and loyalty\-recognition programmes, including eligibility records, approved awards, procurement coordination and event logistics.
* Maintain accurate records of recognition items and ensure expenditure remains within approved budgets and processes.
* Forums, Town Halls and Stakeholder Events: 5%
* Support the planning and execution of seafarer forums, vessel town halls, leadership visits, conferences, seminars, roadshows and sponsorship activities.
* Coordinate participant lists, invitations, venues, suppliers, presentation materials, awards and event budgets.
* Liaise with regional offices, vessels, manning partners and internal functions to ensure timely and efficient delivery.
* Maintain event plans, cost trackers, records and post\-event actions.
* Calendar and Travel Coordination: 5%
* Manage the Head of Fleet Personnel’s calendar, including scheduling, prioritising and resolving conflicts across internal and external meetings.
* Anticipate scheduling requirements and ensure adequate preparation time for leadership meetings, operational reviews and external engagements.
* Coordinate domestic and international travel, including flights, accommodation, visas, invitation and coverage letters, ground transport and supporting documentation.
* Prepare and reconcile travel and business expenses through the applicable company expense\-management system.
* Provide timely support when travel arrangements or meeting schedules change outside standard office hours.
* General Departmental and Administrative Support: 5%
* Support vendor onboarding, invoice documentation, purchase coordination and routine departmental administration in accordance with approved processes.
* Coordinate office, equipment and logistical requirements for the Head of Fleet Personnel.
* Respond to routine stakeholder enquiries or direct them to the appropriate responsible person.
* Perform other reasonable duties assigned by the Head of Fleet Personnel in support of departmental priorities.


**Technical Skills**
**Key Skills and Capabilities**
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Outlook, Excel, Word, PowerPoint and Teams.
* Strong email organisation, correspondence tracking and action\-management capability.
* Ability to prepare professional correspondence, presentations, reports, dashboards, project plans and structured trackers.
* Strong digital and physical document\-management skills.
* Experience with enterprise systems such as COMPAS or other crew\-management systems, NetSuite, Certify, Concur, SharePoint or similar platforms would be an advantage.
* Ability to work accurately with operational, financial and personnel data.


**Professional Skills**
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
* High level of discretion, confidentiality, integrity and professional judgement.
* Strong project coordination, planning, organisation and stakeholder\-management skills.
* Ability to work independently, anticipate requirements and manage a high volume of competing priorities.
* Strong attention to detail, responsiveness and consistent follow\-through.
* Ability to engage confidently and respectfully with senior executives, seafarers, vessel teams, unions, manning partners, vendors and colleagues across cultures and time zones.
* Calm, dependable and solution\-oriented approach, particularly when handling urgent or sensitive matters.
* Resilience and the ability to maintain accuracy and professionalism in a fast\-paced, high\-intensity environment.


**Professional Experience And Education**
**Education**
* Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Commerce, Human Resources, Maritime Studies or a related discipline.


**Experience**
* At least five years of relevant experience in Fleet Personnel coordination, project coordination, executive support or senior administration, preferably supporting senior leadership.
* Demonstrated experience managing high\-volume email correspondence, multiple projects and concurrent deadlines in a demanding work environment.
* Experience in the maritime, ship\-management, crewing or logistics sector is preferred.
* Prior exposure to seafarer administration, CBA or union coordination, audit support, management reporting, travel, insurance, employee events or welfare programmes would be an advantage.


**Additional Requirements**
* Willingness to commit to a high\-intensity and high\-volume work environment, supported by prior experience in a role requiring sustained responsiveness and effective prioritisation.
* Availability on a 24/7 basis, when operationally necessary, to support meetings or urgent matters outside standard office hours due to Seaspan’s global operations.
* Flexibility to coordinate with stakeholders across international time zones and respond promptly to changing operational priorities.
* Ability to travel occasionally when required for Fleet Personnel forums, events or leadership support.
* Demonstrated commitment to Seaspan’s values, safety culture, confidentiality requirements and standards of professional conduct.


 Seaspan Corporation is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, race, colour, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or protected Veteran status. We thank all applicants in advance. If your application is shortlisted to be included in the interview process, one of our team will be in contact with you.

**Role**
 The role is responsible for independently managing end‑to‑end Talent Development processes across India. This includes training coordination, stakeholder engagement, content support, performance management cycles (Connected Conversations), talent review processes, learning systems administration, reporting and communication management.
   

  

 This position ensures seamless delivery of all talent development initiatives across the business, working closely with stakeholders, SMEs, global teams and external partners.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Learning Needs \& Stakeholder Engagement** 
  

* 
+ Engage with business stakeholders to understand functional needs and recommend Unit/Function‑specific training and development plans.
+ Support the identification of skill gaps, learning needs and interventions required at an operational level.


**Learning Program Management** 
  

* 
+ Independently plan, schedule and coordinate all learning events and capability‑building programmes.
+ Work with internal SMEs and external partners to scope, design, create and adapt training content.
+ Manage end‑to\-end logistics, communication, attendance, and completion follow‑ups for all training initiatives.


**Learning Systems \& Content Administration** 
  

* 
+ Act as the single point of contact for learning systems including Connected Learning, LinkedIn Learning, other LMS platforms, induction/training resources, and course catalogues.
+ Upload, maintain and monitor training content, learner assignments, completions, and reporting accuracy.
+ Maintain and periodically update induction material, learning pathways, and guidance resources.


**Learning Communication \& Knowledge Management** 
  

* 
+ Independently manage all L\&D communication channels including SharePoint pages, Compass pages, newsletters and learning campaign messaging.
+ Ensure content is updated, user‑friendly, and promotes high employee engagement.


**Performance Management (Connected Conversations)** 
  

* 
+ Manage the entire Connected Conversations cycle including communication rollout, training and awareness sessions, query resolution, monitoring completion and facilitating escalations.
+ Track progress and ensure timely closure of the performance management process across India.


**Talent Review \& Calibration Support** 
  

* 
+ Drive the annual Talent Review and Calibration process by coordinating schedules, collecting data, maintaining templates, and supporting facilitation.
+ Partner with the Talent Development Business Partner to ensure smooth execution and documentation.


**Global \& Group Development Programmes** 
  

* 
+ Facilitate the nomination and selection process for Group/Global development programmes for India.
+ Support implementation and communication of Group programmes and contribute inputs as required.


**Data, Reporting \& Insights** 
  

* 
+ Prepare periodic and on‑demand reports on training effectiveness, feedback, training hours, nominations, and completion metrics.
+ Analyse L\&D budget utilisation vs spend and highlight variances.
+ Provide insights to continuously improve the learning experience.


**Continuous Improvement** 
  

* 
+ Contribute to the development and updating of L\&D processes, policies, frameworks, and resources.
+ Recommend innovative tools, methodologies, and technologies to enhance learning delivery and impact.


**Key Skills \& Competencies**
* Strong coordination and project management
* Excellent communication (written and verbal)
* Stakeholder management
* Learning system/LMS administration (SAP Success Factors and Articulate Rise is preferred)
* Content curation and basic design capability
* Data analysis and reporting
* High attention to detail and ownership
* Ability to manage multiple tasks independently
* Digital mindset and tech savviness

 \*Company:\* Trance Interiors LLP
 



 \*Department:\* Human Resources

  1\. JOB PURPOSE
 



  





 The HR Intern will support the HR Department in day\-to\-day HR operations, recruitment, employee coordination, documentation, attendance management, onboarding, employee engagement, and HR process development.

 \* Conduct initial communication with candidates.
 



 \* Maintain candidate databases and recruitment trackers.
 



 \* Follow up with candidates regarding interview attendance and joining status.

 B. Employee Onboarding
 



  





 \* Coordinate the joining process for new employees.

  F. Employee Engagement

 \* Collect employee feedback where required.

  G. Performance Management \& HRIS

 \* Support Employee of the Month evaluation processes.
 



  





  H. Learning \& Development
 



  





 \* Assist in identifying employee training requirements.
 



 \* Coordinate training sessions and workshops.
 



 \* Maintain training attendance and participation records.
 



 \* Collect employee feedback after training programs.
 



 \* Assist in preparing training calendars.
 



 \* Maintain Learning \& Development documentation.
 



  





  I. Employee Communication
 



  





 \* Draft and circulate HR\-related communications.

 \* Communicate interview schedules, joining instructions, HR notices, and internal announcements.
 



 \* Maintain professional communication with candidates and employees.

  J. Exit \& Separation Support
 



  





 \* Assist in the employee resignation and exit process.

 \* Coordinate exit formalities and clearance requirements.
 



 \* Assist in collecting exit feedback.

 \* Coordinate with relevant departments for exit\-related documentation.
 



  





  





  





  3\. DAILY HR ACTIVITIES
 



  





 The HR Intern may be responsible for:

 \* Following up with candidates.
 



 \* Scheduling interviews.
 



 \* Updating recruitment trackers.
 



 \* Maintaining employee records.
 



 \* Coordinating with employees and reporting managers.
 



 \* Updating HRIS / HR application data.
 



 \* Preparing HR reports and documents.
 



 \* Supporting ongoing HR activities.
 



 \* Handling routine HR coordination and administrative work.
 



  





  





  





  4\. SKILLS REQUIRED

 \* Basic knowledge of MS Word.
 



 \* Good email drafting skills.
 



 \* Basic understanding of recruitment processes.
 



 \* Ability to maintain trackers and databases.
 



 \* Basic understanding of HR functions.
 



 \* Willingness to learn HRIS and HR technology.
 



  





  Soft Skills
 



  





 \* Good verbal and written communication.
 



 \* Professional attitude.
 



 \* Good interpersonal skills.
 



 \* Ability to coordinate with multiple people.
 



 \* Attention to detail.
 



 \* Good organizational skills.
 



 \* Time management.
 



 \* Follow\-up skills.
 



 \* Positive and learning\-oriented attitude.
 



 \* Ability to maintain confidentiality.
 



  





  





  5\. EDUCATIONAL QUALIFICATION

 Freshers and candidates looking to gain practical exposure in Human Resources are encouraged to apply.

 The HR Intern's performance may be evaluated on:
 



  





 1\. Recruitment coordination and follow\-up.
 



 2\. Interview scheduling accuracy.
 



 3\. Candidate database maintenance.
 



 4\. Employee documentation accuracy.
 



 5\. Attendance and leave record accuracy.
 



 6\. Timely completion of HR tasks.
 



 7\. Employee communication and coordination.
 



 8\. HRIS data accuracy and updates.
 



 9\. Support provided for onboarding and induction.
 



 10\. Support for employee engagement activities.
 



 11\. Report and tracker maintenance.
 



 12\. Discipline, punctuality, and attendance.
 



 13\. Confidentiality and professionalism.
 



 14\. Ability to meet assigned deadlines.
 



 15\. Learning ability and initiative.
 



  





  





  8\. CAREER DEVELOPMENT / LEARNING AREAS
 



  





 During the internship, the HR Intern will receive practical exposure to:
 



  





 \* Recruitment \& Talent Acquisition
 



 \* Interview Coordination
 



 \* Employee Onboarding
 



 \* HR Documentation
 



 \* Attendance \& Leave Management
 



 \* Employee Engagement
 



 \* HR Operations
 



 \* HRIS
 



 \* Performance Management
 



 \* KPI Management
 



 \* Learning \& Development
 



 \* Employee Relations
 



 \* HR Policies \& Procedures
 



 \* HR MIS \& Reporting
 



 \* Exit \& Separation Process
 



  





  





  9\. PERSONAL ATTRIBUTES
 



  





 The candidate should demonstrate:
 



  





 \* Professionalism
 



 \* Discipline
 



 \* Punctuality
 



 \* Ownership of assigned responsibilities
 



 \* Confidentiality
 



 \* Positive attitude
 



 \* Willingness to learn
 



 \* Accountability
 



 \* Good follow\-up
 



 \* Teamwork
 



 \* Adaptability
 



  





  





 10\. WORKING HOURS
 



  





 \*Working Hours:\* 10:00 AM to 7:00 PM

 The employee/intern may be required to support urgent HR activities or business requirements outside normal working hours when reasonably required.
 



  





  





  11\. REPORTING \& COORDINATION
 



  





 The HR Intern will report to the \*HR Executive / HR Manager\* and will coordinate with:

 \* Site Supervisors

 \* Job Candidates
 



  





  





  12\. CONFIDENTIALITY
 



  





 The HR Intern will have access to confidential employee and company information. All employee records, salary information, personal documents, HR reports, and internal company information must be kept strictly confidential.
 



  





 Any unauthorized sharing, copying, or disclosure of confidential information may result in appropriate disciplinary action as per company policy.
 



  





  





  13\. SUCCESS PROFILE

Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, or disability status.  If you're passionate about talent acquisition, learning new HR practices, and making an impact in a rapidly growing company, we invite you to apply!
 



  





 Apply Now!
 



 Become part of Mavenwit and build your career in HR and Talent Acquisition!**

title: Deputy General Manager - Organisation Culture & Engagement
description:
**Job Requirements**
 About Godrej Industries Group (GIG)
   

  

 At the Godrej Industries Group, we are privileged to serve over 1\.1 billion consumers globally through our businesses with market leadership positions in the consumer products, real estate, agriculture, financial services and chemicals industries
   

  

 www.godrejindustries.com
   

  

**About Godrej Properties Limited (GPL)**
 Godrej Properties brings the Godrej Group philosophy of innovation, sustainability, and excellence to the real estate industry. Each Godrej Properties development combines the over 125\-year legacy of excellence and trust with a commitment to cutting\-edge design, technology, and sustainability.
   

  

 www.godrejproperties.com
   

  

 Position Overview
   

  

 The DGM — Organisation Culture \& Engagement will be the custodian of Godrej Properties' people culture — defining what it means to work here, making that real across every level of the organisation, and building an engaged workforce that drives business outcomes. This is a senior individual contributor and influencing role, working closely with the Head\-COEs, CHRO and business leadership.
   

  

 Culture Architecture \& Activation
   

  

* Define, articulate and embed the Godrej Way culture framework — values, behaviours, and ways of working — across the employee lifecycle
* Partner with business leaders to ensure culture is lived and not just stated, with visible behavioural anchors at every level
* Design and run culture diagnostics to identify gaps between desired and current culture; build action plans against findings
* Lead culture integration work during periods of organisational change, growth, or restructuring


 Employee Engagement
   

  

* Own the GPL engagement measurement strategy — design, run, and analyse engagement surveys (including Gallup, Amber or equivalent) across the organisation
* Translate engagement data into actionable insights; work with HRBPs and business heads to drive meaningful interventions at function and team level
* Build and sustain a cadence of engagement touchpoints — pulse checks, focus groups, manager\-led rituals — that keep the organisation connected and energised
* Drive recognition frameworks that reinforce culture and sustain engagement beyond survey cycles


 Manager \& Leadership Enablement
   

  

* Build capability among people managers to drive engagement within their teams — playbooks, toolkits, coaching nudges
* Partner with L\&D to embed culture and engagement into leadership development programmes
* Work with senior leaders to role\-model and cascade cultural behaviours visibly


 Measurement \& Reporting
   

  

* Own the engagement and culture scorecard; report progress to CHRO and leadership team quarterly
* Define and track MOPs: engagement scores, manager effectiveness, culture index


 Who are we looking for?
   

  

* 2019\-2021 batch passout from premier b\-schools
* Demonstrated experience running large\-scale engagement programmes (Gallup Q12 preferred)
* Strong diagnostic ability — comfortable with data, surveys, and translating numbers into people insights
* Excellent stakeholder management and influencing skills — this role works across levels without direct authority
* Strong written and verbal communication — able to build narratives, write well, present confidently
* Experience in real estate, infrastructure, or similarly project\-driven, distributed organisations is a plus


 What Success Looks Like in Year One
   

  

* Engagement score improvement to 85th percentile for the BU
* Engagement survey completed, results socialised, and function\-level action plans live
* Culture framework documented and activated with visible behavioural markers
* Manager enablement toolkit deployed


**Work Experience**
 6–8 years
   

  

**Benefits**
 What’s in it for you?
   

  

 Be an equal parent
   

  

*Maternity support, including paid leave ahead of statutory guidelines, and flexible work options on return*
*Paternity support, including paid leave*
*New mothers can bring a caregiver and children under a year old, on work travel*
*Adoption support; gender neutral and based on the primary caregiver, with paid leave options*
 No place for discrimination at Godrej
   

  

*Gender\-neutral anti\-harassment policy*
*Same sex partner benefits at par with married spouses*
*Gender transition support*
 We are selfish about your wellness
   

  

*Comprehensive health insurance plans, as well as accident coverage for you and your family, with top\-up options*
*Trust based sick leave*
*Mental wellness and self\-care programmes, resources and counselling*
 Celebrating wins, the Godrej Way
   

  

*Structured recognition platforms for individual, team and business\-level achievements*
*Performance\-based earning opportunities*
 https://www.godrejcareers.com/benefits/
   

  

 An inclusive Godrej
   

  

 Before you go, there is something important we want to highlight. There is no place for discrimination at Godrej. Diversity is the philosophy of who we are as a company. And has been for over a century. It’s not just in our DNA and nice to do. Being more diverse \- especially having our team members reflect the diversity of our businesses and communities \- helps us innovate better and grow faster. We hope this resonates with you.
   

  

 We take pride in being an equal opportunities employer. We recognise merit and encourage diversity. We do not tolerate any form of discrimination on the basis of nationality, race, colour, religion, caste, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, disability, age, or marital status and ensure equal opportunities for all our team members.
